Blow apart!

Don't underestimate me!
No. 10, deploying!
Ugh! You...!
Dammit, I took too many hits...
Kisaragi... did you see me in action?
Heading out!
Disappear!
You won't get past me that easily.
Am I going down...?
Are they using me for target practice?!
At this rate, the terminal's...!
Don't let your guard down. This is only the beginning.
I won't let them have their way!
Life doesn't always go as you want...
This won't go just like training.
To think even I'm losing my nerve...
I won't let you do as you please!
Too easy...
You can't beat us humans!
Dammit... I'll never forgive you!
I can't afford to lose...!
How dare you do this to our town... I'll make you pay!
Defend this position!
Did I get it?!
This is bad... At this rate...
What's going on...? Everyone... You can hear me, right? Answer me! Hey!
Looks like it worked... Thanks to everyone.
Let's keep it up! We'll all survive this together!
Our town...
Is there something we can do...?
We've got to defeat them quickly...
I won't forgive you!
At least this one!
Cover me!
I'll wipe them all out...
Hah... hah... I've taken too many hits.
Looks like they've locked on to me.
It hit!
Aah! That's awful...
Huh? Am I being targeted?
I'm fine. I'll go.
Maybe I'm getting used to this...
I'll stop their advance!
Did it hit?
That was a good hit!
Look! I took down the kaiju!
It's not having any effect?
Enemies! They've appeared!
The terminal's in danger!
That was rough... but it looks like we made it.
Come on, I can do this!
How's that?!
Stop!
Did it hit?
What?! Did I get hit?!
No... Everyone... I'm so sorry...
I'll go.
The enemy's movements...
Don't let our chance slip away...
I'll crush them.
I'll do it.

Target neutralized.
This is dangerous...
Damn it!
Damn it! They've done something to me!
No choice but to do it.
I don't wanna be dead weight...
Go!
Hit!

Stay down!
I'm not gonna lose!
Damn... I've really taken a beating...
Hah... hah... This is rough...
Did I miss?
Enemies?!
The terminal can't take much more!
Gotta know when to pull back...
Come on... Just work properly...
I'd win a fistfight, but...
Take this!
Rest in peace.
Ugh... Damn you!
Don't mess with me!
You made a fool of me!
At this rate, I'll be scrap...

Enemies!

Tch... Just you wait...
Hey! Hang in there! You guys can hear me, right?! Answer me!

Our town... Damn it!

Is there a good move...?
How should we attack?
There!
At this range...!
I'll put up a shield.
I'll step up our attacks.
Caught them off guard?
Activating No. 22!
What?!

The terminal's taking hits!

Is Juurou going too?
Let's go!
I'll take them down!
How's that?
Did I take it down?
I took it down.
Not a single one gets past me...
Juurou!
Juurou... No, please... Juurou!
Juurou, I will protect you. No matter what.

Kurabe Juurou

Relying on memories entrusted to him by Izumi Juurou, Kurabe Juurou boards his Sentinel.
He faces a game that will decide the fate of the world.

Kurabe Juurou gets questioned by Miura Keitarou, the other lodger.
It turns out that he's unable to see Kurabe's friend, Shiba Kyuuta.

Kurabe Juurou recalled a memory from the past during his visit to Tokisaka
Shrine with Ogata Nenji. Shiba Kyuuta was the one who transferred from
the android to Kurabe.

Kurabe Juurou's living situation with Yakushiji Megumi is discovered by Minami Natsuno,
so he ends up having to accept her request of taking in another lodger.

Kurabe Juurou was hanging out at Amiguchi Shuu's house with Shiba Kyuuta.
He didn't want to go home, fearing that his nightmare of killing
Yakushiji Megumi would end up happening in real life.
Izumi Juurou

Kurabe Juurou accidentally heard the conversation between Yakushiji Megumi
and Gouto Renya. He's troubled by the fact that there's another version
of himself that goes by the name Izumi Juurou.

After hearing about Fuyusaka Iori's premonitions, Kurabe Juurou started
to recall the shootout dream he told her about in the science room.

Kurabe Juurou went to Shinonome Ryouko for help and discovered the truth about
Shiba Kyuuta. The confusion sends Kurabe's consciousness further into darkness.

Fuyusaka Iori is sleep-deprived from the nightmares she's been having.
She discovered that her classmates Kurabe Juurou and Amiguchi Shuu have
been having the same dream too.

Fuyusaka Iori remembered the dream where she and Kurabe Juurou searched
inside a UFO. The kaiju, disappearing civilians, the countdown... It all
sounded like something from a sci-fi movie.

In her dream, Fuyusaka Iori was alone when a schoolboy arrived in a robot.
He looked just like Amiguchi Shuu.
Sumire Bridge, Dream of Shooting Juurou

While cleaning the science room, Fuyusaka Iori is enveloped in a mysterious light.
When she wakes in the nurse's office, she recalls memories of 'him'
from her dreams.

Find the cat, then call out
to Sawatari and the others

Fuyusaka Iori returned to the science room in hopes of seeing "him" in the
future again. But instead, she found out there's someone else he cares about.

After delinquents harass Fuyusaka Iori, 'he' saves her from danger.
Before he leaves, she resolves to tell him
how she feels.

Just like Sekigahara Ei said, the kaiju appeared in town. Fuyusaka Iori
activated the Sentinel she received from Sekigahara to protect those
important to her.
Morimura Chihiro's Confession

Yakushiji Megumi vowed she'd make a deal with the devil if it would bring back
Izumi Juurou, her lover who lost his memories.

After hearing from Shippo, Yakushiji Megumi rushes to the abandoned factory and rescues Kurabe Juurou.
She discovers that his memories are not those of the Izumi Juurou she knew.

The next target was Kurabe Juurou's friend, Amiguchi Shuu. Although she
succeeded in shooting him, it resulted in the sudden appearance of a
giant robot, all of which was witnessed by Juurou.

Yakushiji Megumi shot Fuyusaka Iori, her rival for Kurabe Juurou's affection. What Sawatari
Miwako said while shielding Fuyusaka made Yakushiji suspect that she alone could see Shippo.

Yakushiji Megumi remembers the day she made her deal with Shippo. Even though she did
it for Kurabe Juurou, she's tormented by having aimed a gun at her best friend's back.

Yakushiji Megumi is made to shoot 'witches' with a magical gun.
One of her targets, Sekigahara Ei, was once Juurou's comrade in arms.
Shippo and I

Shippo really was trying to bring back Kurabe Juurou's memories. As meteors
were descending, Yakushiji Megumi activated her Sentinel to help Juurou.
Enter a Contract With Shippo

The fugitive Sekigahara Ei, who has lost his memory, learns
about the world's true nature from his past self.

Sekigahara Ei remembered that this loop is their final chance. Once the battle
began, he summoned his Sentinel to secure a future with Fuyusaka Iori.

Sekigahara Ei encounters Fuyusaka Iori, who has feelings for him.
He recalls his past conversation with Morimura and the others,
and with it the full details of Operation Aegis.

As Fuyusaka Iori shows him around school, Sekigahara Ei meets two girls.
Hearing the phrase 'busybody' reminds him of a droid
he once encountered in the form of a girl.

Following a message from the telephone message service, Sekigahara Ei
meets Minami Natsuno and Takamiya Yuki. A message from his
'best friend' reveals that he once conspired with Ida Tetsuya.

Following the travel log of a motorcycle he once rode, Sekigahara Ei
heads to the abandoned factory. He had asked Okino Tsukasa
to back up his memories.

After following Yakushiji Megumi and the others, Sekigahara Ei encounters
Miura Keitarou. Hearing Miura's name brings back the promise
he made to the AI of Sentinel No. 17.

Questioned by a
Police Officer
Flashback: Morimura Chihiro
Settle Things With Ida Tetsuya

Gouto Renya continues to seek the truth. While in the saucer,
he discovered footage of an elderly version of himself.
The Murder of Morimura Chihiro

Gouto Renya and Morimura Chihiro exchanged words at Ayame Park.
Based on the logs he found, Gouto deduced that she is actually
Professor Morimura Chihiro.

The battle has begun. Gouto Renya worried for Chihiro, but she ignored his
warnings. Once she confirmed the feelings he had towards Morimura,
she joined Sawatari Miwako and Kisaragi Tomi to evacuate.

Gouto Renya uncovers one truth after another that Chihiro wants hidden.
He begins to suspect she intends to destroy this world.
Gouto Renya's Theory 2

After interacting with Sawatari Miwako and the others, Chihiro decided to
evacuate 1.2 million civilians to Sector 3.
Gouto Renya's Log
Gouto Renya's Theory 3

Gouto Renya correctly identified Chihiro as Morimura-sensei's killer.
To silence him for knowing too much, Chihiro pointed a gun at him.
Gouto Renya's Theory 4
Gouto Renya's Theory 1

Gouto Renya proposed a bet to see whether the 13 of them could solve the
problem on their own. When there were only two terminals left standing,
Chihiro gave Gouto one last chance.

To protect the alien she met in the track clubroom,
Minami Natsuno sets off on an adventure across time and space.

Minami Natsuno and BJ arrived in 2065 to find Sentinel No. 17. Upon finding
remains that looked like BJ, Minami discovered that he's actually a robot
manufactured by Shikishima.
Track Clubroom
My Childhood Friend Is With the Men in Black

Minami Natsuno flees the men in black suits to protect BJ.
During her escape, she sees her best friend, Takamiya Yuki,
involved with them.
Track Clubroom 2
Death Droid

Minami Natsuno escaped into the bathroom to hide from the sudden
attack by Kisaragi Tomi. Minami felt relief after Kurabe Tamao saved
her, but it turned out Tamao was after her as well.

Minami Natsuno and BJ searched for BJ's deleted memory data in the
2105 underground facility. Once he regained his memories, BJ said that
Sentinel No. 17 is up in orbit in the artificial satellite.
Track Clubroom 3
An Encounter Across Time and Space

In search of Sentinel No. 17, Minami Natsuno and BJ arrived in 1945,
but were spotted by a local boy, Miura Keitarou, at the Tokisaka Shrine.

Minami Natsuno and BJ arrived in 2025 to go to the saucer. However, Shinonome
Ryouko suspected that she was working alongside 426 and snatched
BJ away, leaving Minami stranded and unable to return to 1985.

BJ disappeared at the same time Minami Natsuno summoned Sentinel No.
17. Minami swore to follow through with the promise she made to BJ.

Miura Keitarou was chosen as a cadet for a new weapon.
When his hometown was attacked, he boarded a Sentinel to defend his country.

Miura Keitarou reunited with Minami Natsuno, whom he first met in 1945,
and ended up staying at the Kurabe House at her suggestion.

The scout unit Minami Natsuno calls BJ showed Miura Keitarou a log from
2188. The footage stated that Takamiya Yuki is Minami's mother.

As Miura Keitarou faced off against the American weapons, he and his Sentinel
were engulfed by a bright light. He awoke to find himself in 1985 Japan.

Returning to 1945, Miura Keitarou learns from a dying Kurabe Tamao
that Chihiro has been taken away. Those are her final words
before she disappears.

BJ turns out to be Miura Keitarou from the previous world. Knowing he is about to
disappear, BJ entrusts Miura with one final wish.
My Younger Sister

After Miura Keitarou heard Gouto Renya mention Sekigahara Ei's name,
he recalled a time in 1944 when he met a suspected spy.

On Judgment Day, Miura Keitarou recovers Sentinel No. 19 with
Hijiyama Takatoshi's help. He boards it to protect those
he holds dear, including his family.

Hijiyama Takatoshi ended up in 1984 after chasing Douji Kiriko.
Six months later, he reunited with Kiriko, who's actually Okino
Tsukasa. Together, they made a promise.

While following Okino Tsukasa through school, Hijiyama Takatoshi
encounters Yakushiji Megumi again. He remembers that the girl
who once gave him yakisoba pan also shot him for no clear reason.

Hijiyama Takatoshi heads to Tokisaka Shrine to find Okino Tsukasa
and get him to explain how they can save everyone. Inside the saucer
Okino leads him to, the two unravel the mysteries of their world.

Examining the unconscious Ogata Nenji yields no results.
Okino Tsukasa then examines Hijiyama Takatoshi,
laying bare feelings that Hijiyama had kept hidden.

As told by Miura Keitarou upon their reunion, Hijiyama Takatoshi came upon
empty ruins and packs of inactive Deimos after returning to 1945.

At school, Hijiyama Takatoshi finds Sekigahara Ei.
From footage shown by Sekigahara's scout unit, he hears
that Okino Tsukasa has died, leaving him deeply shaken.
Reach Tokisaka Shrine First

Share Information With Okino at
the Underground Saucer
Underground Saucer

As the kaiju invasion begins, Hijiyama Takatoshi heads into the final battle to protect
his homeland and the people he loves—and to make sure he never loses Okino again.

Ogata Nenji experienced the same train accident twice. A voice in his
head told him to find the key as it began for a third time.

Based on what the Izumi Juurou from another world said, Ogata Nenji realized
that Minami Natsuno was the one with the key. However, he also learned
that sharing this information might jeopardize Minami's safety.

When Ogata Nenji confronts Okino Tsukasa, the source of the mysterious
voice, the scenery suddenly changes. Ogata realizes that
he has been restrained in Okino's hideout.

Izumi Juurou's message led Ogata Nenji to Yakushiji Megumi, who was waiting
for him. She cast a spell on Ogata, enabling him to fight the kaiju.

Ogata Nenji chased Fuyusaka Iori onto a train and encountered a little girl.
She changed her appearance between Fuyusaka and Morimura, which
caused Ogata to recall a forgotten memory from the past.

To change a future in which the train accident keeps repeating,
Ogata Nenji escapes the station with Kisaragi Tomi. But the
surrounding city is already overrun with hordes of kaiju.

Ogata Nenji found Shinonome Ryouko and Sekigahara Ei collapsed on
the floor inside the train. As he reported back to the mysterious voice,
he caught a glimpse of the person behind the static.

With the help of Yakushiji Megumi, Ogata Nenji managed to escape
the abandoned factory. At the final battle, Ogata boarded his
Sentinel to protect the woman he loves.

A refugee from the future, Kisaragi Tomi, was suddenly shifted
to a desolate world along with her friends.

Kisaragi Tomi and Ogata Nenji find the wreckage of Sentinel No. 13.
Kisaragi had seen it before Morimura and the others took her away.

Kisaragi Tomi and Yakushiji Megumi were reunited in 1985. Kisaragi
heard that Yakushiji's lover, Izumi Juurou, lost his memories.

Using the underground gate, Kisaragi Tomi and the others returned to 1985,
but Sawatari Miwako was nowhere to be found.

Kisaragi Tomi searched Tokisaka Shrine for a way back to the future and
witnessed Okino Tsukasa and Hijiyama Takatoshi using the gate.

Sekigahara Ei, who knows a way back to 1985, rescued Kisaragi Tomi and
Ogata Nenji from an android attack.

Kisaragi Tomi encountered Amiguchi Shuu and Minami Natsuno after 
arriving at the underground gate with Okino Tsukasa. They saved Inaba
Miyuki, who revealed the truth about this world to them.

Amiguchi Shuu woke late at night from a mysterious dream and heard
someone call his name from a TV he thought he'd turned off.

After a dream where he revived Kisaragi Tomi as an AI in the future,
Amiguchi Shuu realized that the Morimura Chihiro from his dream resembled
Fuyusaka Iori.
A World 30 km in Diameter

Led by the idol's voice, Amiguchi Shuu took the highway with Takamiya
Yuki. Beyond the tunnel, they reached the residential district's outer wall.

Amiguchi Shuu recalled the time he met Miura Keitarou in his dream,
as well as a heart-stopping memory with Kisaragi Tomi.

To restore Kisaragi Tomi to her original body, Ida Tetsuya attempted to extract
information from 426, but 426 tricked him and took over Kisaragi instead.

Amiguchi Shuu was shifted into a Sentinel that appeared out of nowhere
and ended up in outer space. When he returned to the surface,
Ida Tetsuya forced him to cooperate.

Upon hearing Inaba Miyuki's SOS, Amiguchi Shuu made his way to Sector 3
with Shinonome Ryouko. The rescue mission resulted in a failure, and Amiguchi
was left behind until Minami Natsuno showed up.
Transmission With Inaba Miyuki

Flashback: Transmission With
Inaba Miyuki
Transmission with Inaba Miyuki 2

Takamiya Yuki transferred over to Sakura High School for an SIU mission.
She started her own investigation after learning about the disappearance
of her best friend, Minami Natsuno.

Items left behind after the incident in the girls' bathroom
point to Kisaragi Tomi as a suspect. But a witness report
suggests there may have been two Kisaragis.

In the old school building, Takamiya Yuki found Shinonome Ryouko
watching footage. Shinonome broke down in tears and asked Takamiya
to hide the projector. She later lost her memories.

Through Detective Onishi, Takamiya Yuki found a lead on Minami Natsuno's
disappearance. She infiltrated a Shikishima facility, where she learned
from Gouto Renya and the others that she's also a Sentinel pilot.

Sekigahara Ei activated the projector Takamiya Yuki hid in the old school
building. Relying on the information from a robot called Miura, they
headed for Sector 3.
Encounter Morimura-sensei
A Disembodied Criminal

Aiba Erika's true identity turned out to be an android that carried the
consciousness of the criminal Izumi Juurou. The android managed to break
past Morimura and the others to escape from Takamiya Yuki.
Nacchan

After learning Minami Natsuno's whereabouts, Takamiya Yuki shot down
the android blocking her way, then held Natsuno tightly in both arms.
Flashback: Izumi Juurou
Flashback: Yakushiji Megumi

Shinonome Ryouko received a harsh truth from Morimura and Gouto Renya.
By the time the final battle began, Shinonome had lost a majority
of her memories and activated her Sentinel.

Shinonome Ryouko confused Kurabe Juurou with the Izumi Juurou she
remembered. She recalled how Izumi had saved her from kaiju in the past.

While searching for a lead on 426, Shinonome Ryouko recalled the
memory of her own Sentinel when she met her replacement pilot,
Yakushiji Megumi, at the Sentinel hangar.
Looks Like Sensei

Seeing Amiguchi Shuu somehow reminded Shinonome Ryouko of Ida
Tetsuya and caused her to recall an important past event regarding Ida.

When the one she cherishes is taken away, Shinonome Ryouko
is consumed by revenge. She corners someone she believes is 426,
but passes out from a severe headache.

Shinonome Ryouko recalled when she broke ties with Ida Tetsuya.
Ida had been trying to reset the world to save Kisaragi Tomi.

Shinonome Ryouko recalled the day she cornered 426 in the science room.
However, Sekigahara Ei was neither 426 nor the culprit of the incident.

Shinonome Ryouko was unsettled by the medication records she saw in the
nurse's office. Morimura told her that her disappearance was imminent.
