A transmission between Miura Keitarou and Minami Natsuno. As the second colony began operating, the ethics committee's intervention complicated the project. Miura took a keen interest in the Pacific War fought two centuries earlier. They ended the call looking forward to meeting during their next break.

A transmission between Miura Keitarou and Kurabe Tamao. Professor Kurabe is the leading authority on AI who served as Professor Morimura's former teacher. Using her memories and surviving old film footage, they plan to recreate the Kurabe residence, which was originally built in the twentieth century.

A transmission between Miura Keitarou and Morimura Chihiro. Five residential Sectors, each modeled on a different era, were being constructed. Everyone agreed to start over before the nanomachine war, but couldn't agree on the ideal era. They settled the dispute by creating residential areas based on five different periods.

When Hijiyama Takatoshi learns that Yakushiji Nozomu is infected, he locks the doors to protect the colony. Major Izumi rushes to the scene and orders Hijiyama to open the airlock, then takes Nozomu’s daughter Megumi into his care.

A transmission between Takamiya Yuki and Morimura Chihiro. Adjustments to the probes and the genetic data of all fifteen people were completed successfully, and the two placed their hopes in their own clones. When genetic testing revealed something about 'him', Morimura decided not to interfere.

A transmission between Morimura Chihiro and Sekigahara Ei. Sekigahara confronts Morimura with the crimes she has committed. He detonates a bomb he planted in the power-generation area, then heads to where she is.

A transmission from Ida Tetsuya to Gouto Renya. He reports that someone had modified the settings for the final phase, causing Morimura Chihiro's memories to be overwritten. According to the changelog, the one who did this was none other than Izumi Juurou.
Ogata Kengo

A log between Shikishima CEO Gouto Renya and Chairman Ogata Kengo. Ogata, who had died about a year prior, speaks from an AI backup stored within Morimura Chihiro's administrative data. He reveals that he was the one who ordered Morimura to sell the nanomachines, sowing the seeds for this disaster.
A memory of a dream Fuyusaka Iori had. Three teenagers discover a mysterious countdown in what appears to be the ruins of a spacecraft.

A memory of a dream Kurabe Juurou had. As the Earth's crust collapsed, three teenagers tried to escape from inside the UFO. Okino operated the device to send them to Sector 0, but could not set its timer. Sacrificing himself, he managed to transfer Izumi Juurou and Morimura Chihiro without him.

A memory of a dream Kurabe Juurou had. Thanks to Okino's sacrifice, Izumi Juurou and Morimura Chihiro were successfully sent back to Sumire Bridge in the year 2089. Holding on to hope for the future, the two begin walking again.
A memory of a dream Kurabe Juurou had. A man and woman succeeded in destroying a facility tied to a space project, only to be attacked by their pursuers at the place where they were hiding.

One of Kurabe Juurou's memories. Prisoner number 426, Izumi Juurou, is questioned in an underground interrogation room. Under the strict supervision of Officer Onishi, young Izumi Juurou and Okino Tsukasa are brought in, but neither admits to recognizing him. Before the interrogation can come to a close, news comes in of a kaiju attack.
My Name is... Ida Tetsuya

A memory of a dream Amiguchi Shuu had. Kisaragi Tomi stands in shock next to her crumbling apartment building as he attempts to console her. Miura Keitarou and Morimura Chihiro come to rescue them, and he reveals that his name is Ida Tetsuya.

A memory of a recurring nightmare that Kurabe Juurou has. In the devastated city center, he slaughters students one by one. Just as he's about to fire the final shot at Amiguchi Shuu, Morimura Chihiro takes him down.

A memory of a dream Amiguchi Shuu had. It's Judgment Day—the day the kaiju have made their assault, breaking through the last line of defense. To put an end to the fight, Morimura Chihiro sacrifices herself to send him back to Sumire Bridge, 16 years into the past.
A memory of a dream Fuyusaka Iori had. As she stands atop the bridge, a boy named Ida Tetsuya warps in on a huge, walking tank. To avoid any further commotion, the two leave the area together.

A suspicious woman approaches the 7-year-old Ogata Nenji. Ogata mistakes her for a member of the League of Darkness and desperately runs away. She catches up and shoots nanomachines into his body using her gun.

A memory of a dream Fuyusaka Iori had. Izumi Juurou confronts Morimura Chihiro on Sumire Bridge and asks her to let him pass. But Morimura cannot overlook the four people he killed in this world, and pulls the trigger.

After eight years of research, Ida Tetsuya developed an android and implanted Kisaragi Tomi's consciousness into it. When Kisaragi awakened as an AI, Morimura told her that a certain man had murdered her.

Kisaragi Tomi, recently revived as an android, tells Morimura Chihiro about the explosion during the transfer. Realizing that Ida Tetsuya had lied about Izumi Juurou's murders, Morimura is crushed by regret.

Ida Tetsuya tries to extract information from 426, whom he's installed in an android. Kisaragi Tomi appears and objects to his plan to restore her to a human body. When Ida attempts to erase 426 from the android, Kisaragi and 426 switch places, allowing 426 to escape.

Ida Tetsuya realizes that Kisaragi Tomi and 426 have switched places. He decides to reset everything and start over once more, hoping to revive Kisaragi in a living human body from the very beginning.

Around the time Gouto Renya began working with Morimura Chihiro and the others, he analyzed the mainframe and discovered recordings from 2188. They contained corporate information relating to innerlocitors.
Sentinel Pilot Izumi Juurou
As a commercial building panics at the arrival of the kaiju, Shinonome Ryouko wanders through it searching for her friends. Just as a kaiju is about to attack her, Sentinel No. 13 saves her life.
Shinonome Ryouko, who had been rescued from the initial kaiju attack in 2064, begins to harbor feelings for Ida Tetsuya.

Just before the full-scale kaiju invasion, Morimura Chihiro and Ida Tetsuya are talking on the roof of a commercial building when Sekigahara Ei arrives. Wondering why Ida asked him to update the Sentinel systems instead of consulting Morimura, Sekigahara questions Ida about Operation Aegis.
MIURA KEITAROU

Miura, the AI of Sentinel No. 17, tells Sekigahara Ei about the records from 2188. Morimura had already isolated the records, but Miura had backed them up to Sentinel No. 17's memory block beforehand. He asks Sekigahara to retrieve the block without fail if the Sentinel is badly damaged.

Ida Tetsuya asks Shinonome Ryouko to install the Sentinel upgrade code DD-426. She does as he asks, but rather than installing it to her own Sentinel No. 14, she installs it to No. 15— Sekigahara Ei's Sentinel.

The full-scale invasion of the kaiju has begun. While on defense, the Sentinels start going haywire. Thanks to Morimura Chihiro's quick decision-making, they're able to force-transmit the Sentinels to safety, but not before suffering heavy losses.

Yakushiji Megumi and her best friend, Kisaragi Tomi, walk through Satsuki Pond Park on their way home from school. Out of nowhere, a giant robot crash lands into the water before their eyes, along with a strange boy known as Izumi Juurou.
The Day Ida-sensei Saved Me

Due to the incident of 2064, Shinonome Ryouko and her Sentinel have been force-transmitted to 1984. While she is under police interrogation, Ida Tetsuya steps in and uses his authority with the Special Investigations Unit to take her into his protection.

Due to the incident of 2064, Sekigahara Ei has been force-transmitted to the underground research facility in 2104. Androids awaken and begin to attack, but are shot down by a strange girl with braids. She tells him she can create pills to delay the effects of DD-426, under one condition: he must help her get out of there.

Hijiyama Takatoshi and Miura Keitarou have been chosen to become pilot cadets for the new Japanese military weapon, the Sentinel. Kurabe Tamao and Douji Kiriko see the two off as they are mobilized to the military arsenal.

Hijiyama Takatoshi takes Miura Keitarou to the armory and shows him Sentinel No. 19. While the two discuss the Sentinel, Douji Kiriko arrives and tells them that synchronization and connection adjustments will soon be carried out.

Sekigahara Ei questions Okino Tsukasa about the effects of DD-426 he is experiencing. Okino says he has already transferred his memories into a simulated personality, leaving him unaffected by DD-426.

Sekigahara Ei, who was being chased down by the military police as a suspected spy, was hiding out in the wooden school building, helped by Kurabe Tamao. Miura Keitarou tries to take him to the station for spouting nonsense at him— such as having fought with a future version of Miura— but Sekigahara holds him off with his gun and leaves.
The Identity of Douji Kiriko

Hijiyama Takatoshi had chased down Douji Kiriko to Tokisaka Shrine, as she was suspected of being a spy. Cornered, she then disappears in a flash of light. Hijiyama learns from a suspicious man who had sneaked into the factory that her real name is Okino Tsukasa, and that she is actually a man.
One day in 1945, at the Kurabe residence, Miura Keitarou discovers a large mark on a pillar. Chihiro had accidentally hit it with a bucket while pretending to defeat a giant ghost.

As the kaiju attack escalates, Kisaragi Tomi tries to find her mother inside a commercial building in the midst of being evacuated. Gouto Renya and Morimura Chihiro are also inside trying to rescue her. Before their eyes Sentinel No. 13 appears, piloted by Izumi Juurou, to fight off the kaiju.

After losing the battle, Sekigahara Ei appears before Ida Tetsuya. Ida promises to take away the effects of DD-426 in exchange for Sekigahara's help in stopping Operation Aegis and bringing about another loop, as well as extracting log data from Miura. Although hesitant, Sekigahara activates Miura.

After losing the battle in 2025, Yakushiji Megumi and Izumi Juurou meet once again in front of the downed Sentinel No. 13. A man that was Izumi's ally appears before them, as Yakushiji holds the heavily injured Izumi in her arms.
Having caught a cold after bathing and weakened by extreme hunger, Hijiyama Takatoshi crouches on the river embankment. A passing girl gives him his first-ever yakisoba pan.
Kisaragi Tomi, originating from 2025, is excited about the unusualness of how things look in 1985. Gouto Renya tells her that she is to attend the Sakura High School of this era.

In the schoolyard, Yakushiji Megumi asks Morimura-sensei about Izumi Juurou's condition. She is told that Izumi has already lost his memories, and is being treated as another personality named Kurabe Juurou.

Kisaragi Tomi is troubled by the unfamiliar era she is in, but reunites with Yakushiji Megumi in the schoolyard. Kisaragi, who thought that Izumi Juurou's attitude was odd, asks Yakushiji the reason for it.

Gouto Renya, who had been called out to the schoolyard, is asked for help by Kurabe Tamao. Fearing that Morimura Chihiro has not given up on implanting 426's memories into Kurabe Juurou, she asks him to keep an eye on Morimura.
Having overslept because of her dream, Fuyusaka Iori makes a mad dash to make it to the morning assembly. She bumps into a male student she doesn't recognize, and instantly falls for him.

Fuyusaka Iori and her good friend Sawatari Miwako get to know their classmate, Kisaragi Tomi. Their childhood friend, Minami Natsuno, and Yakushiji Megumi, who came to call Minami back, also enter the classroom.

Fuyusaka Iori comes to the passageway to look for a cat, but it immediately runs into the bushes and gets away. When she looks back up, she sees Kurabe Juurou and Amiguchi Shuu talking to each other in secretive tones.
Gouto Renya tries to use the gate in the science room, but Morimura Chihiro finds him and objects. Gouto had noticed the change in her attitude, and has been suspicious of her current state.

Fuyusaka Iori meets up with Kurabe Juurou and Amiguchi Shuu at the passageway to the old school building. Fuyusaka has been having strange dreams similar to the other two, and tells them about her dream of the boy who looked like Amiguchi and the tank with legs.
After finding the cat at the front gate, Fuyusaka Iori and Kurabe Juurou make friendly conversation. They greet Kisaragi Tomi as she arrives, and Fuyusaka tells Kurabe about the UFO dream she had.
Fuyusaka Iori is cleaning the science room with Kurabe Juurou. After Kurabe returns to class and leaves her there alone, a glowing field suddenly appears before her.

Fuyusaka Iori reunites with the boy she met before in the ruined world, but they are attacked by autonomous Sentinel No. 8, which is under Deimos control. The shock causes Fuyusaka to faint, and Gouto Renya and Morimura Chihiro later find her lying there.

Gouto Renya had pondered the possibility that Fuyusaka Iori and Morimura Chihiro's biometric ID were the same, and took the unconscious Fuyusaka to the mainframe. Using her biometric ID, he is successful in accessing Morimura's logs.
The Future Gouto Renya
At the mainframe, Gouto Renya looks at Morimura Chihiro's two logs, as well as the log of Gouto Renya from 2188. The Shikishima CEO in the 2188 log calls himself Gouto Renya.

Fuyusaka Iori finds herself in a bed when she wakes. Near her stands her friend Sawatari Miwako, as well as Morimura-sensei and Gouto Renya. Fuyusaka tells them about how she met Sekigahara Ei in the ruined future.

Kisaragi Tomi looks for internal information regarding Shikishima Industries in the reference books she borrowed from the library. She eventually is able to have Sawatari Miwako introduce her to a childhood friend whose father works at Shikishima Industries.
Shinonome Ryouko was waiting in the science room for Sekigahara Ei, and tries to stop him with a gun when he starts working on the gate. While the two struggle, the shift is executed.

In the passageway behind the science room, Kisaragi Tomi unexpectedly meets Ogata Nenji—the boy with the pompadour she met near the station, who also happens to be Sawatari Miwako's childhood friend. As the two bicker, Fuyusaka Iori approaches to call out to them. Before she can, a mysterious flash fills her vision. When it clears, Kisaragi and the others are gone.
Shinonome Ryouko discovers 426's hideout and finally corners him. Just as she decides to take him by force, an intense headache disables her.

Shinonome Ryouko is confused by the fact that Sekigahara Ei is not 426. As she struggles to get through her headache, she is discovered by Kisaragi Tomi and the others who were shifted along with her.
Kisaragi Tomi, Ogata Nenji, and Sawatari Miwako are suddenly enveloped by light. When they come to, they wake up in a ruined city they don't recognize.

Kisaragi Tomi thinks about where she once lived as she looks at what's left of it. At the cake shop on the first floor, she would often eat a pear tart with her friend Yakushiji Megumi, and reminisces about the day she was reunited with her.

Kisaragi Tomi and Ogata Nenji discover a control panel inside the remains of a kaiju. Kisaragi couldn't get any response, but when Ogata does the same, a large monitor suddenly appears. Upon it, images that indicate the kaiju is a piece of terraforming machinery manufactured by Shikishima are displayed.
On the road to Sakura High School, Kisaragi Tomi and Ogata Nenji find the fallen Sentinel No. 13. Kisaragi remembers the day that giant was deployed to protect the city.
Kisaragi Tomi and Ogata Nenji find the missing Shinonome Ryouko on the road near Sakura High School. When the nearby androids activate and try to attack them, a boy with a gun appears.

To escape from 2025, Kisaragi Tomi and company decide to go down the giant hole. Taking Sawatari Miwako with them, once they get near Sakura High School they find Shinonome Ryouko and Sekigahara Ei confronting each other.

Kisaragi Tomi and company make it to the shifter 300 m underground. As Kisaragi touches a mysterious display, she is able to communicate with the missing Sentinel No. 16. But the transmission is quickly cut off, and they are attacked by androids once again. The shift is executed right as they are in danger, and they escape 2025.
As they complete their shift from 2025 to 1985, they notice Sawatari Miwako is nowhere to be found.

The sukeban girl, Takamiya Yuki, is scouted by the man with glasses from the Special Investigations Unit to infiltrate Sakura High School as a spy. Takamiya rolls her eyes at the outrageous assignment of monitoring students who are suspected of being related to weapons development, but then she sees Minami Natsuno's name on the list.

Amiguchi Shuu happens upon Takamiya Yuki, who's being harassed by Wajima Takemi's delinquent gang from Kuri High. To get her out of the situation, he punches Wajima and gives her a ride on his motorcycle.

Amiguchi Shuu convinces Takamiya Yuki to ride on his motorcycle with him and they succeed in getting away. Amiguchi, hearing she's going to be transferring to Sakura High School, feels they were fated to meet and gets excited.
Amiguchi Shuu drops off Takamiya Yuki and then witnesses the nurse from Sakura High School, Morimura Chihiro, enter the Shikishima building.
The Idol Inaba Miyuki
It's midnight as Amiguchi Shuu stirs awake from his dream. That's when the idol on the TV, Inaba Miyuki, starts talking to him.
Kisaragi Tomi talks to Sawatari Miwako about what happened in 2025, but Sawatari seems to have completely forgotten about it.

After waking up from the dream of shooting Kurabe Juurou, and wanting to meet with the cute boy again, Fuyusaka Iori decides to go back into the science room. She seeks out Sawatari Miwako, who's on cleaning duty that day, to unlock it for her.
Having snuck into the science room, Fuyusaka Iori tries to shift again. Unable to find any clues, she says a magical spell out of desperation and the very same light from before appears.

Fuyusaka Iori manages to shift into the UFO that was in her dreams. As she investigates the alien-like dolls and the machinery, the boy she likes appears along with Shinonome Ryouko. Fuyusaka, who had been hiding behind the androids, feels saddened by seeing how he feels about Shinonome.
Kisaragi Tomi, wanting to confirm the theory that all the people in town are managed by Universal Control, suggests they return to 2025, but is stopped by Ogata Nenji.
Nacchan and Yuki-chan
Takamiya Yuki, who just transferred to Sakura High School, makes her way over to the track team. There, she is reunited with her best friend, Minami Natsuno, whom she hasn't seen in several years.

After the forced transmission from 2064, Sentinel No. 14 is back in Morimura Chihiro and company's possession. Yakushiji Megumi is introduced as a new pilot for the Sentinel, but Shinonome Ryouko is strongly opposed to this.
The Life of Minami Natsuno

Minami Natsuno is a lover of aliens, UFOs, and the supernatural, ever since she was in elementary school and given the nickname "Dr. Space." She looks forward to UFO programs, even as a high schooler.
While participating in track team activities, Minami Natsuno encounters strange men in black suits, as well as a mysterious student.

In the track clubroom, Minami Natsuno has a fated encounter with the alien, BJ. Minami hides BJ in her P.E. bag and heads toward the shrine near the school, looking for the "Gate" he's been wanting to find.
Minami Natsuno arrives at BJ's destination: Tokisaka Shrine. She gets excited when she sees the brightly lit shifter gate appear before her.

Minami Natsuno shifts to a devastated city with BJ. According to a news report, this is Kasumi-cho in the future, where BJ has come to search for a memory cell. Minami runs from the area to escape the giant alien weapons destroying the city.

Minami Natsuno and BJ shift to the Sakura High School of 1945. Just as she expresses her awe in seeing the brand new old school building, the two of them hear voices and hide. They learn from a conversation between a male and female student that a weapon lies at Ayame Pass.
Minami Natsuno and BJ arrive at the military factory at Ayame Pass. While they don't find Sentinel No. 17, they do find Sentinel No. 19, which had been piloted by one of BJ's friends.
After a mysterious boy changes the gate's lock, Minami Natsuno and BJ can no longer return to their own era. They are found by a boy wearing a school cap.

Returning to town on leave from factory duty for the first time in several months, Miura Keitarou spots a mysterious light at Tokisaka Shrine. There, he has a fateful encounter with Minami Natsuno, who is hiding in the shade of the trees.

Due to the air raid from the U.S. military, the residential area that included Kurabe Tamao's family home is burnt to the ground. Miura Keitarou searches for Tamao and his sister, Chihiro, as sparks fly about.
Miura Keitarou and the others run away from the strange-looking new American weapons. Leaving Chihiro and Minami Natsuno to Kurabe Tamao, Miura runs off to the Sentinel to mount a counterattack.
After Miura Keitarou and Minami Natsuno leave, Gouto Renya appears before Kurabe Tamao, who is suffering from a chronic illness, and takes Chihiro away.

Getting into Sentinel No. 19, Miura Keitarou takes on the new American weapons. However, he is unable to take on the sheer number of enemies by himself, and gets close to the operation limit. As he makes up his mind to charge in for a suicidal attack, the Sentinel is suddenly enveloped in a mysterious light.
Miura Keitarou gets out of his Sentinel. Instead of being surrounded by houses burning from the flames of war, he sees a skyscraper-lined great city before him.

Minami Natsuno and BJ, who had been hiding in the maintenance hatch, were able to return to their own time in Sentinel No. 19. Miura Keitarou is already gone and Minami and BJ leave before people start to gather.

Miura Keitarou enters the shopping district, bewildered by the unfamiliar clothing and bustling streets. He angers a student with an especially conspicuous hairstyle, who strikes him with his bag and knocks him unconscious.
Miura Keitarou wakes in a spacious room. Records, projection equipment, and a textbook describing future events leave him bewildered. He eventually realizes he's in 1985.
Within the ruined city of 2025, Gouto Renya and Chihiro, a clone of Morimura Chihiro, talk about the compatible ones. They then leave for 1985 to give a status report of the last five years.
Gouto Renya and Chihiro arrive at the riverbed in 1985. After gazing at the sunset, she is filled with a somewhat nostalgic feeling, then goes along with Gouto to the residence.

Minami Natsuno and BJ are being chased by the black suits and hide in a classroom. Natsuno is shocked to find out that her best friend, Takamiya Yuki, is working alongside the mysterious organization.

Yakushiji Megumi cries by herself for Juurou, who has become a different person. Kurabe Tamao approaches and tells her she can arrange for her to live with Juurou. Agreeing to her terms, Yakushiji accepts the rental agreement for the Kurabe residence.

Yakushiji Megumi, a girl in the same year as Kurabe Juurou, suddenly moves into his house. Kurabe thinks it's a joke, but she shows him the rental agreement that she received from Kurabe Tamao, his grandmother. Although Kurabe did not know her well, Megumi acts as if she had known him from before.
Minami Natsuno is relieved that she found her top secret notebook, but is suddenly shot at by Kisaragi Tomi and makes a run for it.
While running down a corridor of the north school building toward the art room, Sawatari Miwako spots Minami Natsuno and Kisaragi Tomi, whose leg is bandaged.
Fuyusaka Iori and Kisaragi Tomi wait for Sawatari Miwako at the front gate. Sawatari runs up and starts to tell them she just met Minami Natsuno, but a bus arrives, and they hurry aboard.
Death Droid

Minami Natsuno hides in one of the stalls in the girls' bathroom. Outside of the stall, the machines get into an intense battle. As things become quiet, Minami comes out of the stall only to be shot in the cheek by the android that looks like Kurabe Tamao.

Fuyusaka Iori, Kisaragi Tomi, and Sawatari Miwako all try to go home, but Wajima Takemi gets in their way. Luckily, Heizo Onishi of the juvenile division, who had been in the area, helps them get away.

Fuyusaka Iori and Sawatari Miwako are harassed by Wajima Takemi and his friends, who were lying in wait. Wajima falls for Fuyusaka at first sight, terrifying her, but the boy she met before comes to her rescue. Afraid she might never see him again, Fuyusaka races after him.

Fuyusaka Iori returns to Tsutsuji Station as she runs after the male student. She finally finds him, but sees that he's been caught by a black suit. To save him, Fuyusaka hits the man with all her might. With Takamiya Yuki's help, Fuyusaka and the boy get away safely on a motorcycle.

To get away from the black suits, the two flee the area on a motorcycle. On the way to her house, Fuyusaka Iori admits her feelings for him. The boy, whose name is Sekigahara Ei, is surprised, but accepts her feelings.

Miura Keitarou, who was searching for clues to get back to his era, is reunited with Minami Natsuno in front of the school. Hearing Minami's words that she'll "take him to the Kurabe House," Miura remembers what happened in the house he lived in.

Kurabe Juurou wakes up from a nap in the living room to see that Yakushiji Megumi had just been making dinner. As he helps with the preparation, Minami Natsuno barges into the house. In exchange for keeping the secret of him living with Yakushiji, she asks Kurabe to let Miura Keitarou stay at the house.

Minami Natsuno brings Miura Keitarou to the Kurabe house in 1985. Its interior looks strikingly like the Kurabe residence that should have burned down in 1945. But the mark that should still be on the pillar is missing.

Unable to return to his own era, Miura Keitarou visits Ayame Pass, where the factory once stood. It is now a park. He sees a girl who resembles Chihiro, but is told she is related to the young man with her. His concern for his younger sister only grows.
Miura Keitarou goes to the athletics building in search of Minami Natsuno. To discover the truth about time travel, the two head to the old school building.

Minami Natsuno tells Miura Keitarou that she has been helping the alien BJ. BJ looks to Miura like nothing more than a Sentinel scouting device, and says he is searching for the Sentinel he arrived in. BJ then shows Miura some footage.

Miura Keitarou visits the athletics building with questions about why Minami Natsuno, a person of this era, showed up in 1945. He is not able to find her, but is asked about his relation to her from members of the track team. Thanks to the team manager's info, Miura heads toward Tokisaka Shrine.

Miura Keitarou arrives at Tokisaka Shrine and witnesses the moment that Minami Natsuno and BJ shift. Miura follows them in to make sure that Chihiro is safe in his own time... But that shift was also witnessed by someone else.
Miura Keitarou returns to 1945 with the others and they leave Tokisaka Shrine to search for Chihiro.

Miura Keitarou and company make their way to the Kurabe residence, unnerved by the fact that not a single other person is around. There they find Kurabe Tamao on the ground, weakened and near-death. She tells Miura that Chihiro was taken by Gouto Renya, and then vanishes without a trace.

Miura Keitarou goes to Sakura High School in search of clues about Gouto Renya. One of Minami Natsuno's friends shows him a picture, and he recognizes him as the man that was at Ayame Park with Chihiro.

To find Gouto Renya, Miura Keitarou heads toward Ayame Park and meets the little girl from before. Miura is relieved that she is indeed Chihiro, but is troubled by how different she seems. When Gouto finally shows himself, he tells Miura that Sekigahara Ei is trying to kill her.

Returning to 2065 to search for a Sentinel, Minami Natsuno learns that both BJ and the tripods are robots manufactured by Shikishima. BJ also suggests that this is not Earth and that Minami herself might be an artificially created alien.

Minami Natsuno and BJ shift to the underground facility in 2105 to access the quantum computer and find the location of Sentinel No. 17. They discover that Sentinel No. 17 is located on a man-made satellite.
Gouto Renya and Chihiro arrive at the mainframe. To stop the manufacturing of kaiju at the automated factories, Chihiro uses her senior admin ID to try and access the mothership.

Minami Natsuno goes to Sector 3 to find the saucer, but is shot by Shinonome Ryouko, who had been lying in wait. When she comes to, BJ is nowhere to be found and Minami realizes that she has been trapped in 2025.

Finding herself near the old school building, Takamiya Yuki sees Shinonome Ryouko watching a projection from a box-like device. Shinonome is unstable and looks like she might collapse, so she asks Takamiya to hide the device for her.

When Shinonome Ryouko wakes in the nurse's office, she takes the pills from Takamiya Yuki and swallows a mouthful of them. Takamiya asks why she was supposed to hide the device, but Shinonome has completely forgotten that she asked her to do so.
Nacchan's Gone
Takamiya Yuki worries because Minami Natsuno has not been coming to school. Questioning classmates and friends, she learns that the Special Investigations Unit appears to be involved.
Takamiya Yuki presses the director of SIU, Ida Tetsuya, for answers. He tells her to not pursue Minami Natsuno's disappearance, but this only strengthens her resolve.
Takamiya Yuki and Aiba Erika search for clues around Tokisaka Shrine, hoping they can find something that will lead to the reason behind Minami Natsuno's disappearance, but they find nothing.

Takamiya Yuki goes to the girls' bathroom to find the truth about the fire incident. The inside is heavily damaged, but not from a fire. She discovers red glasses on the floor... and has an idea of who they might belong to.

Still searching for any clues that might lead to Minami Natsuno, Takamiya Yuki questions Kisaragi Tomi about the girls' bathroom. Sawatari Miwako says that she saw Tomi in the north school building at the time of the incident, but Fuyusaka Iori confirms that Kisaragi was already with her at the front gate during that time.

Takamiya Yuki was taken in by Heizo Onishi for fighting Wajima Takemi and his boys, and is told that there's been several heavy machinery accidents occurring lately. Takamiya thinks that it has something to do with the robot described in Minami Natsuno's notebook and decides to head to the shipbuilding docks where the machinery is being stored.

While on the way to the shipbuilding docks, Takamiya Yuki talks to Ogata Nenji, who happened to be on the train as well. According to him, Aiba Erika in class 1-D has been absent from school for a long time.

Takamiya Yuki is able to sneak into the Shikishima docks, but is met by Shinonome Ryouko and Gouto Renya. There, a mark she doesn't recognize appears around her collarbone. They reveal that she, too, has a connection to the Sentinels.

Takamiya Yuki, now remembering what the device Shinonome Ryouko asked her to hide looked like, goes back to the classroom and pulls out the box she stashed there earlier. She struggles to figure out how to activate it, and Sekigahara Ei shows up just in time to do so with ease. Along with this robot he calls Miura, they head to Sector 3, where Minami Natsuno has been stranded.
Sekigahara Ei and Miura head to Tokisaka Shrine, the place that was mentioned in Minami Natsuno's notebook as well. They shift to Sector 3 through time travel, but are unable to find Minami.
When Takamiya Yuki visits the old school building, Sekigahara Ei has discovered a broken droid resembling Kisaragi Tomi inside a cleaning-supply closet.

Confronted with the evidence, Aiba Erika reveals that her true identity is Izumi Juurou. After Morimura Chihiro shoots him and leaves him badly wounded, Izumi narrowly escapes by jumping off the bridge and disappearing.

Kurabe Juurou witnesses a male student shoot someone. As things begin to settle, Kurabe cautiously walks toward the scene, but the fallen android gets up and attacks him. The android's consciousness enters Kurabe's nanomachines and before he realizes what's happening, a boy named Shiba Kyuuta appears before him.

Yakushiji Megumi follows Kurabe Juurou up the stairwell and a mysterious talking cat, "Shippo", appears before her. He proposes a contract to Yakushiji. If she has a chance to save Kurabe, Yakushiji thinks she'd even make a deal with the devil.
At Gouto Renya’s request, Kurabe Juurou and Fuyusaka Iori tidy the science room. After putting away the beakers Fuyusaka asked him to take care of, Kurabe tells her about his dream of a shootout.
To Nacchan
Led by Miura, who found a location that had an unnatural gathering of androids, Takamiya Yuki sets out to rescue Minami Natsuno.

With the gun given to her by Sekigahara Ei, Takamiya Yuki takes down the attacking androids. At the end of her long search, she finally finds Minami Natsuno. The two of them embrace each other like they never want to let go.

Yakushiji Megumi approaches Kurabe Juurou, who is sleeping in the living room. Shippo appears at his side and presses the contract on her once again. To bring Kurabe back to normal, Yakushiji makes up her mind and agrees to the contract with Shippo.
Gouto Renya—Witch!

Yakushiji Megumi calls Gouto Renya out to the passageway of the old school building. She then shoots the very first "witch" with her Magical Gun, beginning the fulfillment of her contract with Shippo. According to him, those shot with the Magical Gun will have hazy memories around the shooting.

Still struggling to accept how much Chihiro has changed, Miura Keitarou visits the athletics building because he wants to hear Minami Natsuno’s voice. Seeing her in a panic, he asks what happened and learns that BJ is missing. They split up to search for him.
The Past Miura Keitarou
Troubled by Sekigahara Ei's words, Miura Keitarou asks BJ if BJ is really him. BJ confirms it, but explains that he is not Miura from the future: he is someone who once was Miura.
Amiguchi Shuu unexpectedly runs into Miura Keitarou in the passageway. He recalls a recent dream in which Miura appeared.

Amiguchi Shuu meets up with Fuyusaka Iori at the old school building passageway. As they talk about the dreams they had, they realize that they both had the same dream. In an effort to get to the bottom of the mystery, Amiguchi tells Fuyusaka about the dream he had the other day.
Waking in his room late at night, Amiguchi Shuu speaks to Inaba Miyuki through his television. He learns that she is breaking into broadcast programming to communicate with him.

Kurabe Juurou feels that something is off about his school and everyday life. While talking with his friend Shiba Kyuuta in class, he is asked by Sawatari Miwako to take papers from the teacher’s desk to the nurse’s office.
Kurabe Juurou takes the stack of papers to Morimura-sensei in the nurse's office. Once there, he finds a mysterious medication record on the desk with the name "Izumi Juurou" written on it.

Kurabe Juurou meets Miura Keitarou at the shopping district and touches his forehead, which activates Sentinel No. 13. Shiba Kyuuta meddles with Kurabe's memories after saying something meaningful, as if he knows what happened.
Miura Keitarou—Witch!
One night, Yakushiji Megumi shoots fellow houseguest Miura Keitarou with the Magical Gun. Shippo says someone has already performed a procedure on Miura to force him to use magic.
Behind the Abandoned Factory

In Higoromo-cho, Hijiyama Takatoshi finally reunites with the one he was looking for, Okino Tsukasa. Okino promises Hijiyama that if he helps him see his work through to the end, he'll do whatever he wants.
Searching for Okino Tsukasa, Hijiyama Takatoshi visits his old school, Sakura National School. But after forty years, both its name and its appearance have changed considerably.

Hijiyama Takatoshi enters the old school building and remembers his first time meeting Douji Kiriko. Hijiyama grins to himself as he thinks of her, unaware that Okino Tsukasa is standing right in front of him.

Several hours after parting from Okino Tsukasa, Hijiyama Takatoshi wakes from a nap in a classroom in the old school building. Unable to wait for Okino's return, he heads out to explore Sakura High School.

When Hijiyama Takatoshi returns to the old school building passageway, he finds Okino Tsukasa confessing his love to Ogata Nenji. Shocked, Hijiyama lets his emotions get the better of him, and he punches Ogata, knocking him out.

Hijiyama Takatoshi and Okino Tsukasa look through Ogata Nenji's brain. Unable to detect a D-Code command signal from him, they discover that the person sending out the signal has changed. As Okino examines further, however, he finds clues toward the current signal broadcaster within Ogata's brain.
Right after the train derailment, Ogata Nenji finds himself back on Platform 5 at Kamazumi Station with Kisaragi Tomi, where they were just moments ago. He believes time has rewound.
While Ogata Nenji and Kisaragi Tomi are riding the train, kaiju suddenly attack the city. At that moment, the train they're on is overturned.

When he comes to, Ogata Nenji finds himself inside an unfamiliar machine. Confused, a voice suddenly calls out to him. The voice commands Ogata to find the "D-Code key," then forcibly turns back time on him.
Before he knows it, Ogata Nenji is standing on Platform 5 at Kamazumi Station once more. Time has rewound once again.
Ogata Nenji takes Kisaragi Tomi outside the station, but the kaiju invasion begins almost immediately, leaving them nowhere to escape.
After coming to, Ogata Nenji finds himself back inside the machine. The mysterious voice promises to save Ogata and Kisaragi Tomi if Ogata is able to find the key.

Ogata Nenji gets on the train in pursuit of Fuyusaka Iori. Fuyusaka's appearance changes over and over in front of Ogata. Once she turns into Morimura Chihiro, she tells Ogata that he used to be the holder of the key, then shoots him.
Ogata Nenji talks to the mysterious voice inside the machine again. Once the voice understands that Ogata is searching for the key at a train platform, it turns back time on him again.

Ogata Nenji gets on the train in pursuit of Shinonome Ryouko. Inside the train, he finds Shinonome and Sekigahara Ei lying on the ground. A mysterious man appears before him and tells him that 15 boys and girls are commanding the Deimos.
When Ogata Nenji talks to the mysterious voice again, the static on the screen clears for a moment, revealing the identity of the voice to be Okino Tsukasa.

After Ogata Nenji chases Okino Tsukasa onto a train, he finds himself back in the machine. With the static on the screen gone, he can clearly see Okino. He also sees Hijiyama Takatoshi next to him, the one he fought at the riverbed.

As Ogata Nenji comes to, he finds himself in an abandoned factory in Higoromo-cho. Held captive by Okino Tsukasa and Hijiyama Takatoshi, Ogata is told that the events at the station were all inside his head. In order for him to find the key, he's sent back to that world once again.

After chasing Kurabe Juurou onto the train, Ogata Nenji learns that Minami Natsuno is the one who holds the key. However, the man protecting her warns Ogata that Minami's safety may be jeopardized if Okino Tsukasa finds out she has the key.
Ogata Nenji wakes up in the machine again and speaks to Okino Tsukasa. Fearing for Minami Natsuno's safety, Ogata doesn't tell Okino the key's whereabouts.
Behind the Abandoned Factory

Hijiyama Takatoshi and Okino Tsukasa step outside the abandoned factory for a break. Soon after Okino leaves for the convenience store, Hijiyama reunites with the girl who gave him yakisoba pan by the river embankment. When he tries to stop Yakushiji Megumi from entering the factory, she draws a gun from her clothing and shoots him.

Kurabe Juurou gives Ogata Nenji a message he received from Izumi Juurou, and Ogata gets on a train to find Yakushiji Megumi. He wakes up in the machine again, but this time, Okino Tsukasa doesn't appear on the screen. Instead, it's Yakushiji, who says she'll cast a spell on Ogata because of his willingness to fight, releasing him from Okino's restrictions.
Behind the Abandoned Factory
With the help of Yakushiji Megumi, Ogata Nenji escapes the abandoned factory in Higoromo-cho. In the alley, he finds Hijiyama Takatoshi, who's unable to move.
Hijiyama Takatoshi wakes to find that Okino Tsukasa has immobilized him and is examining his brain. As Hijiyama struggles, Okino teasingly probes deeper into his mind.

When Hijiyama Takatoshi arrives at the old school building hallway and eats the yakisoba pan he bought at the cafeteria earlier, he remembers his encounter with the Yakisoba Pan Angel from the other day.

In the old school building hallway, Hijiyama Takatoshi happens upon Sekigahara Ei and a Sentinel scout unit. When Hijiyama activates the scout unit, it projects what appears to be a conversation log between Hijiyama Takatoshi and Okino Tsukasa of the future.

Hijiyama Takatoshi returns to the hideout in Higoromo-cho and confirms that Okino Tsukasa is safe, but Sekigahara Ei has tailed him there. Sekigahara has been looking for Okino, saying he needs him as he clutches his head in pain.
With the pills starting to become ineffective, Sekigahara Ei asks Okino Tsukasa to back up his own memories. Okino then begins mapping Sekigahara's brain.
At the old school building, Hijiyama Takatoshi reminisces about his pilot training days. By chance, he reunites with Miura Keitarou, who also happened to be at Sakura High School.

To check Miura Keitarou’s account, Hijiyama Takatoshi shifts to 1945 with Okino Tsukasa. Seeing the devastated landscape and the remains of the Deimos, he realizes that 1945 and 1985 are not connected in chronological sequence.

Kisaragi Tomi goes to Tokisaka Shrine to find a way to shift back to 2025. With seemingly perfect timing, Hijiyama Takatoshi and Okino Tsukasa shift to Kisaragi's location. She calls out to Okino, who's capable of helping her get back to 2025.
Fuyusaka Iori is walking through the shopping district with Kisaragi Tomi and Sawatari Miwako when Sekigahara Ei rides up on his motorcycle and insistently asks her to come with him.
Fuyusaka Iori tells Sekigahara Ei about the dreams she keeps having. Sekigahara tells her that they aren't dreams, but in fact Morimura Chihiro's memories.
Fuyusaka Iori and Sekigahara Ei meet Morimura Chihiro at Ayame Park. There they learn that Morimura is an illusion created by Universal Control.
Yakushiji Megumi returns to the Kurabe House, where Shippo asks how she felt about shooting Gouto Renya. She then remembers the events of that day.
Yakushiji Megumi talks to Shippo at the front gate. She's told to head to the old school building passageway after class.
Yakushiji Megumi witnesses Kurabe Juurou and Fuyusaka Iori having a pleasant conversation in the hallway, filling her with jealousy.
At the old school building passageway, Shippo tells Yakushiji Megumi that her next target is a boy with short hair. According to Shippo, the boy also has a real gun.
Yakushiji Megumi finds the boy with short hair, though he manages to sneak up behind her. Unable to shoot him, Yakushiji realizes the target is a boy she's met before.
Izumi Juurou
Kurabe Juurou witnesses Yakushiji Megumi and Gouto Renya having a private conversation. He hears the name "Izumi" and recognizes it from the medication record in the nurse's office.
Kurabe Juurou and Shiba Kyuuta come to hang out at Amiguchi Shuu's place. As Kurabe's leaving, he tells Amiguchi about the terrible dream he had recently.
Amiguchi Shuu invites Kurabe Juurou over, and they hang out at his house. Before heading out, Amiguchi borrows a videotape from Kurabe.
After Miura Keitarou finishes eating, Yakushiji Megumi talks about the scar on his head. She then remembers the day she shot Miura with the Magical Gun.

Inaba Miyuki tells Amiguchi Shuu she has been showing him Ida Tetsuya's past to understand what Ida is thinking. She also reveals that they are in the middle of Project Ark, intended to save humanity.
A World 30 km in Diameter
Inaba Miyuki tells Amiguchi Shuu that their world is a residential dome just 30 km in diameter. To let him see its outer wall for himself, she opens a section of the Tsuwabuki Bypass.
Amiguchi Shuu asks out Takamiya Yuki on a date at the cafeteria. They get on Amiguchi's motorcycle and head to Takamiya's maternal grandmother's place in the neighboring Hamanashi prefecture.

Amiguchi Shuu and Takamiya Yuki travel through the Tsuwabuki Bypass motorway and arrive at the outer walls. Amiguchi, now seeing the walls with his own eyes, begins to question if every memory he's had outside the city was a lie.

While she investigates the data at the underground facility, Shinonome Ryouko discovers that some of the data has been erased. To find out who erased the logs, she checks the facility's surveillance footage.
Megumi and Shuu's Promise
Yakushiji Megumi and Amiguchi Shuu meet at the front gate, and they make a promise to meet each other on the roof after school.
Yakushiji Megumi heads toward the roof to shoot Amiguchi Shuu, a witch, with her Magical Gun.
Amiguchi Shuu is shot by Yakushiji Megumi on the roof. Moments later, Sentinel No. 20 is suddenly activated.
Amiguchi Shuu—Witch!
When Yakushiji Megumi shoots Amiguchi Shuu, a Sentinel suddenly activates. Kurabe Juurou witnesses the whole event, and Shippo ends up having to manipulate his memories.

On a building rooftop, men in black suits and a suspicious man with glasses spot Sentinel No. 20. The man immediately orders the suited men to contact the government ministries and agencies and the U.S. military.

Amiguchi Shuu, now in Sentinel No. 20, ends up outside of the outer walls. After communicating with Inaba Miyuki, he and his Sentinel begin to fall, and he returns to the residential district once again.

Sentinel No. 20 falls near Ayame Park. Amiguchi Shuu gets out of the Sentinel, and Takamiya Yuki happens to be nearby. As they talk, a suspicious man approaches them, saying he's with a government agency, and presses Amiguchi to cooperate.

Yakushiji Megumi finds out that Shippo really can manipulate memories. Then, as she's told the truth about witches and magic, Yakushiji is ordered to shoot Kisaragi Tomi next, and she remembers the day she agreed to Shippo's contract.

Yakushiji Megumi meets Kisaragi Tomi at the front gate and tells her she's currently living with Kurabe Juurou. Yakushiji, who's been ordered to shoot Kisaragi, feels she doesn't deserve to call Kisaragi her friend, especially after Kisaragi lent her an ear.

Yakushiji Megumi happens upon Kisaragi Tomi, who's lost at rock, paper, scissors, and has to buy bread for Fuyusaka Iori and Sawatari Miwako. Yakushiji chases Kisaragi toward the cafeteria so she can shoot her with the Magical Gun.
Kisaragi Tomi—Witch!
Yakushiji Megumi shoots Kisaragi Tomi with the Magical Gun in the crowded cafeteria and leaves. However, Ogata Nenji is there and grows suspicious.
Ogata Nenji waits for Yakushiji Megumi at the front gate, and Yakushiji runs away from him and heads home. At that moment, Ogata remembers that he was saved by Yakushiji.
Yakushiji Megumi comes home from school and finds out that Kurabe Juurou had a dream about Fuyusaka Iori. Shippo then appears and tells her to shoot the very same Fuyusaka next.
Shippo's Joke?
Yakushiji Megumi spots Shippo at the front gate, but he inexplicably runs away. Moments later she sees him perched on the gate wall, even though he seemed to have fled far away.
Yakushiji Megumi finds Fuyusaka Iori and Sawatari Miwako chatting in the hallway. She takes Fuyusaka along with her to the girls' bathroom.
Fuyusaka Iori—Witch!
Yakushiji Megumi shoots Fuyusaka Iori with the Magical Gun in the girls' bathroom. Sawatari Miwako also reveals she didn't see Shippo on the fence that morning.
Kurabe Juurou learns from Kisaragi Tomi and Sawatari Miwako that his classmate, Shiba Kyuuta, has never existed. Kurabe then realizes he can't recall any specific memories he's had with Shiba.
Kisaragi Tomi witnesses Kurabe Juurou muttering to himself in the classroom after school. Kisaragi leaves a little before Sawatari Miwako to handle some business.
Inaba Miyuki contacts Amiguchi Shuu and tells him Ida Tetsuya is going to erase her. She asks Amiguchi to save her, and as he's leaving, he encounters Shinonome Ryouko.
Amiguchi Shuu and Shinonome Ryouko travel through the Tsuwabuki Bypass motorway and arrive at the outer walls. They get into Sentinel No. 20 and shift to Sector 3.
Amiguchi Shuu and Shinonome Ryouko descend in Sentinel No. 20 from above Sakura High School to the underground terminal.

Amiguchi Shuu confronts Ida Tetsuya, who's taken Takamiya Yuki hostage. Ida then commands Inaba Miyuki's functions to be shut down. Shinonome Ryouko manipulates the equipment to shift herself, Ida, and Takamiya to Sector 4, leaving Amiguchi and the black suits behind. As Amiguchi and the black suits try to find a way out of the mainframe, Minami Natsuno appears.
Goodbye, Ida-sensei
Along with Ida Tetsuya and Takamiya Yuki, Shinonome Ryouko shifts back to Sakura High School's science room. Pointing the phaser at Ida, the same one she took from him, Shinonome bids him farewell.
Kisaragi Tomi meets up with Okino Tsukasa, who's been waiting for her at Tokisaka Shrine. Kisaragi takes her place at the transfer point, and Okino executes the shift.

Kisaragi Tomi and Okino Tsukasa shift to the mainframe, where Amiguchi Shuu and Minami Natsuno are already present. After reestablishing contact with Inaba Miyuki, the group watches a recording of Kisaragi Tomi from 2188 and then hears Inaba's plan to change Universal Control.
Looks Like Sensei
When Shinonome Ryouko wakes up on the bed in the nurse's office, Amiguchi Shuu is there beside her. Once he sees that she's all right, he leaves the nurse's office.
Shinonome Ryouko finds Fuyusaka Iori in the nurse's office. She recalls the day she found a used ampoule beside Fuyusaka's pillow and medication records for both of them on Morimura-sensei's desk.

Miura Keitarou questions Kurabe Juurou at the shopping district, telling Kurabe that they're the only ones there. Miura says there is no Shiba Kyuuta, causing Kurabe to remember a similar conversation from before.
Kurabe Juurou realizes that no one else can see Shiba Kyuuta. Shiba reveals his true identity to Kurabe and hands him a new video.
At the cafeteria, Takamiya Yuki tells Shinonome Ryouko about how Shinonome attacked Ida Tetsuya. She then remembers the surveillance footage she saw in the underground facility.
Kurabe Juurou is on the run from Shiba Kyuuta, who's trying to manipulate his memories. At the nurse's office, Kurabe talks to Shinonome Ryouko about the dreams he's been having.
After Kurabe Juurou tells Shinonome Ryouko about his dreams, she points out that those memories belong to a different Juurou—Izumi Juurou. Her demeanor changes, and she becomes wary of Kurabe.
Confronted by Morimura-sensei and Gouto Renya in the science room, Shinonome Ryouko remembers the day she installed DD-426 in Sekigahara's Sentinel.

In order to get Shinonome Ryouko to remember the password for removing the Sentinel's infection, Morimura-sensei and Gouto Renya reveal to her that they've been letting her roam free for that very purpose.

Shinonome Ryouko wakes again in the nurse's office, with Sekigahara Ei beside her. Morimura-sensei explains that Shinonome's nanomachines have detached from the brain's memory region, leaving her without memories except those associated with learned abilities, such as operating Sentinels and gates. Morimura then announces the cancellation of the Sentinel Project.
Curious about what Okino Tsukasa and the female student were talking about in the break area, Hijiyama Takatoshi decides to lie in wait for them and find out.

Kurabe Juurou and Ogata Nenji meet Hijiyama Takatoshi in front of Tokisaka Shrine. Kurabe thinks he remembers some events that transpired there and looks inside the nearby trash, where he discovers an android that looks like Kurabe Tamao.
While Hijiyama Takatoshi waits for Okino Tsukasa, Ogata Nenji and Kurabe Juurou arrive. Hijiyama and Ogata both wait together for Okino.

Okino Tsukasa takes Hijiyama Takatoshi to the saucer, where Hijiyama learns that the saucer is 30 km in diameter and buried 300 m beneath Ashitaba City. He also discovers the reason why the Deimos attacked 1945 before 1985, as well as all the current information on the innerlocitors and the D-Code.

Kurabe Juurou asks Yakushiji Megumi if he's actually Izumi Juurou. But when Yakushiji avoids answering him, Kurabe gets irritated and runs off. She then remembers the agreement she made with Kurabe Tamao.
Yakushiji Megumi meets Shippo at the front gate, but he immediately runs off. Afterward, she comes across Kurabe Juurou, but they pass by each other.
Juurou Runs
Yakushiji Megumi is talking to Morimura-sensei in the hallway, when Kurabe Juurou approaches and starts talking to Morimura-sensei. After saying something cryptic to her, he suddenly runs off.
Juurou's in Danger!
Shippo tells Yakushiji Megumi that Kurabe Juurou has been taken to an abandoned factory in Higoromo-cho. Moments later Shippo says the distance has grown too great and vanishes.
Okino Tsukasa and Hijiyama Takatoshi are holding Kurabe Juurou captive at the abandoned factory in Higoromo-cho. The Izumi Juurou within Kurabe, also known as 426, reveals the purpose of his actions.
Behind the Abandoned Factory

Yakushiji Megumi rescues Kurabe Juurou from the abandoned factory in Higoromo-cho. However, she finds that the memories within Kurabe don't belong to the original Izumi Juurou. They're the memories of someone else.
In the old school building, Sekigahara Ei registers Fuyusaka Iori to Sentinel No. 15. After explaining the activation marker, Sekigahara parts ways with Fuyusaka.
Sekigahara Ei, who's losing his memories, asks Morimura Chihiro why she wishes to go through with Operation Aegis, as well as why she deleted the logs from 2188.
As Sekigahara Ei is assaulted by the intense pain from his memory loss, a young girl appears before Morimura Chihiro, who meets her end at the hands of the girl.

As the rain hammers down, Sekigahara Ei wakes up in an alley. He's in possession of an odd gun, and beside him lies a dead woman. However, his own memories are lost, and he can't remember what happened. He decides to leave the area for now.
Gouto Renya exits the 9th building of Shikishima Industries. With Morimura-sensei dead, he can no longer rely on Shikishima. Gouto gets in a taxi and heads over to Ayame Park.

Gouto Renya and Chihiro discuss who killed Morimura-sensei. As Gouto realizes there are discrepancies between Morimura-sensei and Chihiro's memories, he theorizes that Chihiro's memories belong to Professor Morimura Chihiro from 2188.
As Gouto Renya speaks about how Chihiro's memories belong to Professor Morimura Chihiro from 2188, he continues to theorize that he and others are clones of the people from 2188.
Gouto Renya deduces Chihiro's motives and concludes that the person who killed Morimura-sensei was Professor Morimura Chihiro, which is who Chihiro really is.

Gouto Renya tells Chihiro that what made him realize she was Professor Morimura Chihiro were the words "design engineer", which she used to describe Miura Keitarou. Then, in order to win in the final battle, he proposes a bet to Chihiro.
Sekigahara Ei
Chased by a man in a black suit, Sekigahara Ei flees to a rooftop. With nowhere left to run, he uses his phaser to stun the pursuer, who claims Sekigahara is 'someone from another dimension.'

After evading the black suits, Sekigahara Ei meets a mysterious girl. He examines the package she left for him, which activates and projects a log from a version of himself from before he lost his memories.
Sekigahara Ei meets Fuyusaka Iori at the front gate and returns her student ID. He doesn't want Fuyusaka to know he doesn't remember her, so he pretends that he still has his memories.
After the men in black leave campus, Sekigahara Ei has Fuyusaka Iori guide him to the nurse's office after school. Along the way, he spots the mysterious girl he met earlier.

With Fuyusaka Iori's help, Sekigahara Ei sneaks into the nurse's office. While Fuyusaka is out looking for the desk key, a mysterious woman and Kisaragi Tomi enter the room together. Kisaragi's remark about a 'hopeless busybody' triggers a memory in Sekigahara.

Returning to the scene of the crime once again, Sekigahara Ei presses the emblem on the key, which calls a motorcycle. He gets on, and on the way to his destination, he discovers that Fuyusaka Iori and Morimura Chihiro have the same biometric ID.
Behind the Abandoned Factory
When he arrives at the abandoned factory in Higoromo-cho, a girl with braids comes out and pushes Sekigahara Ei to recall his memories.

Sekigahara Ei is told by Sawatari Miwako, a friend of Fuyusaka Iori, that the cryptic note was for a message service. Just then, he spots the boy who was receiving the nanomachine treatments as well as the strange girl who pointed a gun at him in the nurse's office. Suspicious that they're connected to the agency, he follows them.

Sekigahara Ei follows the two into the Kurabe House and shoots Izumi Juurou as he shields the mysterious woman. A cat on the television, apparently the mastermind, speaks to him. Miura Keitarou then strikes him from behind, stirring a memory of Miura.

Hijiyama Takatoshi and Okino Tsukasa shift back to the saucer, where several droids unexpectedly attack them. They attempt to return, but control of the console has been transferred elsewhere. Hijiyama manages to shift out, leaving Okino stranded aboard the saucer.
Hijiyama Takatoshi returns alone to Sakura High School. To rescue Okino Tsukasa, he seeks someone able to operate the transfer system.
Hijiyama Takatoshi meets a girl and a scout unit inside the old school building. The girl gives Hijiyama a phaser, and he heads back to the saucer with the scout unit to rescue Okino Tsukasa.
Hijiyama Takatoshi takes down the androids that come at him one by one with the phaser. He runs over to where Okino Tsukasa is lying, and after entrusting Hijiyama with a letter, he vanishes.

Minami Natsuno comes to Sumire Bridge and, at BJ's request, becomes the pilot of Sentinel No. 17. She transmits the Sentinel and asks BJ if the log data was successfully saved, but he doesn't respond.
Seeking Minami Natsuno, Sekigahara Ei heads to the athletics building. There, he finds the mysterious girl who left him the message at the riverbed.
Sekigahara Ei pursues the mysterious girl who keeps running away from him. Almost as if being lured, he follows her into the old school building.

Sekigahara Ei enters the old school building after Takamiya Yuki, the mysterious girl he's been chasing. He ends up finding the girl he was searching for in the first place, Minami Natsuno. The data unit with her shows Sekigahara a log between himself and the other Miura, as well as a log between himself and Gouto Renya from 2188.
Led by Takamiya Yuki, Sekigahara Ei makes his way into the Special Investigations Unit's headquarters.
Sekigahara Ei finally reaches the Special Investigations Unit office, where Ida Tetsuya, his appearance drastically altered, waits with Fuyusaka Iori as his hostage.
Yakushiji Megumi meets a mysterious girl and Gouto Renya at Ayame Park, where she's told of a criminal from the future. Believing she was tricked by Shippo, she runs back to the Kurabe House.
Yakushiji Megumi questions Shippo at the Kurabe House. However, upon hearing that she's the final witch, Yakushiji turns the gun on herself and pulls the trigger.
Shippo and I
Shippo confesses his true feelings to the unconscious Yakushiji Megumi and takes his leave.
Yakushiji Megumi finds a cat that looks like Shippo sitting on top of the front gate. As she thinks of Shippo, she makes up her mind and decides to fight.

As people flee in panic, Fuyusaka Iori reaches the area beneath the pedestrian overpass. Determined to believe in herself, as Sekigahara Ei told her, she activates Sentinel No. 15, which he entrusted to her.
The final battle begins. Kurabe Juurou witnesses Fuyusaka Iori enter Sentinel No. 15.
Kurabe Juurou
Kurabe Juurou and Shiba Kyuuta are on the pedestrian bridge as the final battle begins. With the memories entrusted to him by Shiba, Kurabe activates Sentinel No. 13.
Miura Keitarou and Hijiyama Takatoshi head to the rooftop of the covered building to take back Sentinel No. 19.
With the help of Hijiyama Takatoshi, Miura Keitarou is finally able to recover Sentinel No. 19. To assist Minami Natsuno, he activates Sentinel No. 19.
Using Okino Tsukasa's letter as a guide, Hijiyama Takatoshi activates Sentinel No. 12, which he discovered underwater in Sector 5.

Okino Tsukasa opens up communications to Hijiyama Takatoshi, who's entered Sentinel No. 12. After being told the truth about the world by Okino, Hijiyama goes to protect his homeland and those he loves.
Yakushiji Megumi stands on a building rooftop as kaiju come raining down like meteors, one by one. To help Kurabe Juurou and win this battle, Yakushiji activates Sentinel No. 23.
Shinonome Ryouko sneaks into the empty Sentinel hangar and activates Sentinel No. 14, which was given to her by Ida-sensei.
Sekigahara Ei arrives near Fuyusaka Iori and sees that 12 Sentinels have already been deployed. He activates his new unit, Sentinel No. 11, and joins the fight.

As the final battle rages on, Miura Keitarou's Sentinel No. 19 takes heavy damage. To protect Kisaragi Tomi, Ogata Nenji activates Sentinel No. 10 and faces off against the kaiju, surpassing his operating limit.

After Gouto Renya and the others activate Aegis and seal the terminal, Takamiya Yuki, who has taken refuge on a rooftop, activates Sentinel No. 21 to take over while Gouto temporarily leaves his Sentinel.
Gouto Renya reveals his feelings for Morimura-sensei to Chihiro. He then activates Sentinel No. 22 once again and returns to the battlefield.
Sawatari Miwako runs over to Chihiro, who's standing all alone as the city burns around her. Kisaragi Tomi leads the two of them out of the area.

Kisaragi Tomi and the others flee the burning city, only to find kaiju even in the direction away from the terminal. To help Fuyusaka Iori, who is heading toward the kaiju, Kisaragi activates Sentinel No. 16.
Sawatari Miwako is shifted to the ruined city of Sector 3, among numerous other civilians.
Once Chihiro finishes the mass transfer of civilians, Hijiyama Takatoshi calls on Okino Tsukasa's behalf with a request.

At the Sector 4 mainframe,
Chihiro begins analyzing the
Meta-Skills at Okino Tsukasa's request.

Gouto Renya asks Chihiro to establish a link with Inaba Miyuki aboard the command ship. To give him a chance, Chihiro moves three surveillance satellites into relay positions and begins communicating with Inaba.

After surviving the final battle, the boys and girls awaken from virtual reality and find themselves in the real world. Their long journey has brought them to a second Earth in the direction of Virgo. Praising the miracle they accomplished, Inaba Miyuki ends the transmission.
A recording of Morimura Chihiro and Kurabe Tamao in 2188. Project Ark has succeeded, and human history continues without interruption.
Kurabe Juurou and Yakushiji Megumi emerge from their pods and take their first steps onto a new Earth to carry on human history.
Having restored Sector 4, Ida Tetsuya speaks with Inaba Miyuki aboard the command ship through the mainframe. She sings for him until their connection is lost.

Gouto Renya and Shinonome Ryouko speak with
Chihiro in Ayame Park. The two are researching
whether they can use pods to recreate the town's
AI residents and welcome them to the second
Earth.

Fuyusaka Iori and Kisaragi Tomi return to Sakura High School and reunite with Sawatari Miwako after five years. Meanwhile, Kurabe Juurou and Yakushiji Megumi also reunite with a familiar person and exchange a few words.

Wajima Takemi waits outside Sakura High, looking just as he
always did. When he tells Ogata Nenji he had been waiting for
him, Ogata bursts into tears. At the front gate, Miura Keitarou
and Minami Natsuno are happy to see BJ again. Takamiya Yuki and
Amiguchi Shuu arrive with their child, Konatsu, though things
are awkward between them because of something careless Amiguchi
did.

Hijiyama Takatoshi, Kurabe Tamao and Okino Tsukasa visit the old school building at Sakura High. Hijiyama spends precious time with Okino, even as Okino leads him around. Tamao meets her other self for the first time and tells her about the outcome of the completed interstellar project.

After so long failing to connect with each other,
the two finally reunite and acknowledge their love for one another.

As the story progresses, these files reveal answers to mysteries surrounding people and events. You can unlock the answers by completing defense missions or spending Mystery Points earned in battles against kaiju.
Kurabe Juurou

[Kurabe Juurou] is a 16-year-old student at Sakura High School. He loves tokusatsu films and watches some kind of kaiju movie on video every day. He's mild-mannered and easygoing, but something about his daily life feels wrong. One day, he unintentionally summons a mysterious giant robot.
During the battle of 2025, he sustained brain damage and was nearly reduced to an empty husk. To prevent this outcome, [Morimura] created the new personality [Kurabe Juurou] and implanted it in him.
[Kurabe]'s memories are being manipulated by [Shiba Kyuuta] through video tapes, but [Shiba] is quick to wipe his memory whenever he gets too close to the truth.

According to the medical records in the nurse's office, [Kurabe] was given "NM:A8075" and "B01". He received four doses of "NM:A8075"; from the fifth dose onward, he was given "B01", synthesized by [Kurabe Tamao].
Although the [Izumi Juurou] that [Yakushiji Megumi] knew is nearly gone, [Kurabe] still remembers fighting in the [Sentinel] and his feelings towards [Yakushiji].

When the [kaiju] appear in 1985, [Shiba] can't take part in the battle, so he entrusts everything to [Kurabe]. [Kurabe] then activates [Sentinel No. 13] in order to support [Fuyusaka Iori], who joined the battle before him.
Izumi Juurou (2188)
In 2188, [Izumi Juurou] has the rank of a major, making him the superior of [Hijiyama Takatoshi] and [Yakushiji Megumi]'s father, [Yakushiji Nozomu]. [Izumi] looks after [Megumi] for [Nozomu].
During a shootout over the dwindling energy supply, [Izumi] shot and killed [Okino Tsukasa]. [Izumi] and his companions were then killed by [Hijiyama], [Okino]’s lover.

The system was modified so that [Morimura Chihiro]'s host would have its memories overwritten in the final phase of Project Ark. When [Ida Tetsuya] discovered the change, the access records pointed to [Izumi].

The [Izumi] of 2188 shared an intimate relationship with Professor [Morimura]. Since [Morimura] died before she could execute the memory transplant, [Izumi] carries out her plan of transplanting her memories as Professor [Morimura] into her clone, [Morimura Chihiro].
Fuyusaka Iori

[Fuyusaka Iori] is a female student in the same class as [Kurabe Juurou]. She's an ordinary, cheerful girl who's hard not to like. Her grades are average overall, but vary greatly from subject to subject. [Fuyusaka] is [Sawatari Miwako]'s childhood friend, and used to be classmates with [Amiguchi Shuu] and [Minami Natsuno] too. Due to the strange dreams she's been having, she suffers from insomnia, oversleeps, and even frequently dozes off in class. One morning, in her rush to get to school on time, [Fuyusaka] literally runs into [Sekigahara Ei] at the front gate. It's love at first sight.
[Morimura] had implanted her own memories into [Fuyusaka], but [426]’s intervention left [Morimura]’s memories hazy, like dreams.
Morimura Chihiro (2188)

When [Miura Keitarou] asks her why they didn't create a residential district of the 2180s, [Morimura] explains that the decision was to start over from a time before the world took such a terrible turn. She also notes that they couldn't agree on which era would be ideal, so they ultimately settled on preparing residential districts by era.
In 2188, [Morimura] sold nanomachine technology on the black market to raise funds. That technology contaminated Earth and drove humanity toward extinction.
Genetic tests on the 15 people in Project Ark revealed that [Okino Tsukasa] was [Morimura]’s son. Although [Morimura] had not given birth to him herself, she still felt a mother’s affection for him.
Yakushiji Megumi
[Yakushiji Megumi] comes from the future, the ruined world of 2025. She's easygoing and genuinely believes her Prince Charming will come along.

A cat called [Shippo] appears before [Yakushiji Megumi], who hopes to restore [Kurabe Juurou]’s old memories. [Shippo] offers her a contract: he will restore [Kurabe]’s memories if she carries out his mission in his place.

Though she tends to be serious and holds her emotions close to her chest, [Yakushiji] is very affectionate when it comes to [Kurabe], as seen when she moved into the [Kurabe House] rather forcefully. Moreover, she's a skilled cook who whips up lunch and dinner for [Kurabe] and [Miura Keitarou] almost every day.
[Yakushiji] enters a contract with [Shippo] and uses the [Magical Gun] to shoot [Gouto Renya], [Miura Keitarou], [Amiguchi Shuu], [Kisaragi Tomi], and [Fuyusaka Iori].
[Yakushiji] is the only one who is able to see [Shippo].

While [Yakushiji] is saddened by the fact that [Kurabe] doesn't remember her anymore, she's approached by [Kurabe Tamao], who says she can arrange for her to live with [Kurabe] if she agrees to two conditions. Agreeing to the terms, [Yakushiji] accepts the [rental agreement] for the [Kurabe House].

Overcome by remorse and a sense of responsibility for drawing everyone into battle, [Yakushiji] shot herself with the [Magical Gun]. Awakened by [Kurabe]'s voice, she heard about his memories from when he was [Izumi Juurou] and his feelings for her. [Yakushiji] realized that [Shippo] had been trying to keep his promise.
When the [kaiju] appear in 1985, [Yakushiji] makes up her mind that she'll be the one to save Juurou and beat the game, then activates [Sentinel No. 23].
Yakushiji Megumi (2188)

[Yakushiji Megumi] was eight years old in 2188. As humanity faced the brink of extinction, her father, [Yakushiji Nozomu], entrusted his daughter to Major [Izumi Juurou] in hopes that at least she could survive.
Sekigahara Ei

[Sekigahara Ei] is a boy from another dimension who suffers from memory loss. When he wakes up, he finds the corpse of [Morimura Chihiro] beside him, but has no recollection of knowing her. To make matters worse, he is being chased relentlessly by men in black. He finds a message from his past self, telling him to "escape this world."
[Shinonome Ryouko] was like an older sister to [Sekigahara], who spent a lot of time alone when his parents weren't around. To [Sekigahara], [Shinonome] is family, and he only wants her to be happy.
Before [Sekigahara] lost his memories, [Ida Tetsuya] told him to deceive [Miura] to extract information if he wanted to stop the effects of [DD-426].
Sekigahara Ei (2188)
An assassin hired by 2188 Shikishima CEO [Gouto Renya] to kill [Morimura Chihiro]. He infiltrated Sector 4 disguised as a guard.

The assassin [Sekigahara Ei] had infiltrated Sector 4 as a guard, but [Morimura] confined him to a room. He escaped by detonating a bomb he had planted in the power-generation area, then went after [Morimura] to kill her himself.
Gouto Renya
[Gouto Renya] comes from the ruined future of 2065. Intelligent and composed, he brings the Sentinel pilots together and takes a leadership role among the students.

[Gouto] secretly had feelings for [Morimura-sensei]. After reading a communication sent from [Ida Tetsuya] in 2188 to [Gouto], he began to suspect [Morimura]'s memories had been overwritten by 426. Around that time, [Morimura]'s behavior suddenly changed, deepening his distrust of her.
To access [Morimura-sensei]'s records, [Gouto] took [Fuyusaka Iori], who had fainted in the ruins of 2065 after being startled by a Sentinel, to the UFO mainframe and used her biometric ID.

Guided by [Morimura]'s records at the mainframe, [Gouto] visited the [Kurabe House] in 1945. [Chihiro], a clone of [Morimura], had been living there as a foster child. He took her away and awakened her original memories.

Upon realizing the distinct discrepancy between [Morimura-sensei]'s and [Chihiro]'s memories, [Gouto] considers the possibility that [Chihiro] isn't simply a clone of [Morimura]. After researching the logs of 2188's [Morimura], he theorizes that [Chihiro]'s true identity is instead Professor [Morimura Chihiro] from 2188.
Gouto Renya (2188)

During the acquisition of Newmen, Inc., he used [Morimura]'s space development project as a front to conceal a large sum of illicit money moved through a secret deal. He suspended the project and covered up the evidence. However, an international organization decided to reassess [Morimura]'s project and investigate it. Shortly before nanomachine contamination began, [Gouto Renya] feared that the movement of those funds would come to light, so he hired [Sekigahara Ei] to kill [Morimura] and bring the project to an end.
Minami Natsuno

[Minami Natsuno] is an energetic, straightforward high school girl on the track team. She loves UFO shows on TV and is fascinated by the occult, genuinely dreaming of meeting aliens. Her nickname in elementary school was Dr. Space. She's part of a family of five, including her parents and younger brothers. [Takamiya Yuki] is her childhood friend and closest confidant.
One day, [Minami] finds [BJ] hiding in the track clubroom. He's in search of a memory cell and [Sentinel No. 17], so she decides to help him find them.
She's very close to her neighbor [Granny Tamao] ([Kurabe Juurou]'s grandmother).
In the girls' bathroom, the [Kurabe Tamao android] destroys the [Kisaragi Tomi android], temporarily shuts off [BJ], and shoots [Minami] in the right cheek.

In the ruins of 2065, [Minami] finds what appears to be the brain of one of [BJ]’s destroyed companions. The word “SHIKISHIMA” is engraved on it. To her dismay, [Minami] realizes that [BJ], the [Sentinels], and even the [kaiju] are all machines made in Japan. However, [BJ] suggests that this planet might not be Earth, and that [Minami] and the others could be the real aliens.
[Minami] shifts to 2025 to get to the saucer, but is attacked by [Shinonome Ryouko] there and gets left behind in the ruins, unable to find a way home.
Minami Natsuno (2188)
The 2188 [Minami Natsuno] is Professor [Takamiya Yuki]'s daughter, as well as [Miura Keitarou]'s girlfriend.

In 2188, [Minami] explained Professor [Takamiya]’s research to [Ogata Nenji], the head of Shikishima. Of 117 candidate planets, the leading prospect was a planetary system 12 light-years away. The ark would carry only DNA information; humans would be recreated in the final phase. The projected population was six million, but [Ogata] dismissed the plan as self-indulgent and impractical.
Miura Keitarou

[Miura Keitarou] is a boy who shifted from 1945 to 1985. He's considerate, very earnest, and takes good care of his younger sister. He hides his forehead scar with a hat. [Hijiyama Takatoshi] and [Kurabe Tamao] are both his childhood friends. No one loves his country more than he does.

After shifting to 1985, [Miura] moved into the Kurabe house through [Minami Natsuno]’s introduction. There he tried a huge meatball called [hemborger], made by fellow houseguest [Yakushiji Megumi], and was amazed by how delicious it was.

[Miura]’s forehead scar came from [Okino Tsukasa]’s nanomachine reconstruction scan, devised to get the [Sentinels] running again after [DD-426] disabled them. [Miura] endured pain that nearly drove him mad, completing data that would let the [Sentinels] operate without the effects of [DD-426]. [Okino] then arranged for [Miura]’s data to be forcibly transferred to anyone who came into contact with him.
Miura Keitarou (2188)

In the 2188 world, [Miura Keitarou] is an engineer and [Minami Natsuno]'s boyfriend. He's also an acquaintance of Professor [Takamiya Yuki], [Minami]'s mother. As a history buff, he's particularly fascinated by the Pacific War that occurred two hundred years ago.

He designed the virtual residential districts known as [Sectors], basing them on the five sectors of a space colony. That is why he called these virtual districts [Sectors] as well. He had always wanted to live in the prewar era.
Hijiyama Takatoshi

[Hijiyama Takatoshi] shifted from 1944 to 1984. Proud to have been chosen as a Sentinel pilot, he has an earnest, traditionally masculine manner. Once rough and blunt, he gained a dignified, mature bearing after entering military service in 1944. Six months drifting without a home after his shift brought back his old gruff manner. [Okino Tsukasa] leads him around by the nose because he fell for [Okino] while disguised as a girl, though Hijiyama does not entirely mind. His favorite food is [yakisoba pan].

At an abandoned factory, [Okino] tied [Hijiyama] up and forcibly examined [Hijiyama]’s feelings toward him. Earlier, in an arsenal laboratory, [Okino] had also tampered with code in [Hijiyama]’s brain.
Hijiyama Takatoshi (2188)

The [Hijiyama Takatoshi] of 2188 was in a romantic relationship with [Okino Tsukasa]. He murders [Izumi Juurou] to avenge [Okino]'s death during the shootout in [Sector 4]. However, he was severely injured in the fray, and succumbs to his wounds soon after.
Ogata Nenji
[Ogata Nenji] is a compassionate delinquent with an old-fashioned sense of honor. All the delinquents in town knew of him during middle school, thanks to his fighting skills and nerves of steel.
His father is an executive at [Shikishima Industries], so he grew up wealthy. He is childhood friends with [Sawatari Miwako]. [Sawatari] describes [Ogata] as a boy who never breaks his promises.

When [Ogata] was seven, [Morimura] injected him with nanomachines while he trained to fight the [League of Darkness] in an empty lot beside [Tokisaka Shrine]. This made it possible to manufacture [Sentinels].
[Ogata] was the original holder of the [D-Code] key, but [Minami Natsuno] is the one who currently has it.
When the [kaiju] appear in 1985, [Ogata] swears to protect [Kisaragi Tomi] this time, and activates Sentinel No. 10.
Ogata Nenji (2188)
The 2188 [Ogata Nenji] is heir to the Ogata family behind the Shikishima conglomerate. He opposes [Morimura]’s Project Ark, which his late father had championed.
During a dispute over energy for [Project Ark], [Ogata] drew a gun, setting off a shootout in which [Ogata] was killed.
Kisaragi Tomi

[Kisaragi Tomi] comes from the ruined future of 2024. Her blunt manner can make her seem cheeky, but she is quick-witted and has the strength to overcome adversity. Her nickname is [Usami].
