(Usami is a nickname that plays on her first name, Tomi. The "To" in her name is the same character for rabbit, or usagi in Japanese. "Mi" is one way of reading the Japanese character that means beauty. Usa + mi makes Usami.)
An accomplished singer, she posted performance videos to a video-sharing site in 2024 under the name “Inaba Rabbit.”

Although [Ida Tetsuya] held authorization for [Sentinel No. 16], [Okino Tsukasa], who created the [Sentinels], helped transfer it to [Kisaragi]. This allowed [Inaba Miyuki], whom [Ida] had put to sleep, to be freed.

The idol [Inaba Miyuki], who is also the control system for [Sentinel No. 16] (gone missing after The Sentinel Infection Incident), is the other [Kisaragi Tomi]. [Inaba]'s song sounds just like the song [Kisaragi] used to sing in middle school, but rearranged for an '80s sound. [Kisaragi]'s username at the time was also "[Inaba]."
Kisaragi Tomi (2188)
The 2188 [Kisaragi Tomi] was a [terraforming] researcher who designed the second phase of the interstellar development project.

According to [Kisaragi]'s report dated February 8, 2188, the 25th [terraforming] simulation showed that a type 57B planet would take 1,800 years to become habitable for humans. At Professor [Morimura]'s suggestion, the system was also updated so the command ship could monitor the final-stage surface facilities and decide whether to restart that stage before the facilities were damaged or malfunctioned.
Amiguchi Shuu

[Amiguchi Shuu] comes from a wealthy family, excels at sports, and is something of a playboy. Although flippant, he gets along well with people and is popular with boys and girls alike. Deep down, he finds the world boring. Passing through the shopping district, he saw [Takamiya Yuki] being harassed by [Wajima Takemi] and his group and came to her aid. [Amiguchi] fell for both her cute looks and her physical strength. Lately, he has been troubled by strange recurring dreams and a mysterious girl who speaks to him through his TV.

The strange dreams that [Amiguchi] has been seeing were actually the past experiences of [Ida Tetsuya], who looks near-identical to him. In order to protect "Project Ark," [Inaba Miyuki] expressed that she wants to learn his thoughts.

[Amiguchi] has the same DNA as [Ida]. [Morimura] had implanted [Ida]'s memories from ages 16 to 26 into him. [Ida] also brought [Amiguchi] to [Sector 4] (the 1980s) as a baby and entrusted him to the Amiguchi family.

When [Amiguchi] was shot by [Yakushiji Megumi] on the rooftop, [Sentinel No. 20] activated. Earlier, [Amiguchi] had touched [Miura Keitarou] while carrying [Miura] home after [Ogata Nenji] knocked him unconscious in the shopping district. As a result, [Amiguchi] had already been affected by the forced-activation code for the [Sentinels] that [Okino Tsukasa] had embedded in [Miura].
Ida Tetsuya (2188)

While reviewing the system in 2188, [Ida Tetsuya] noticed that part of its final phase had been changed and reported it to [Gouto Renya]. The changes were set to overwrite the memories of [Morimura Chihiro]'s host. The replacement memories were unknown, but the access records identified [Izumi Juurou].
Takamiya Yuki

[Takamiya Yuki] is a formidable sukeban whose reputation extends to other schools, earning her the nickname “Takamiya of Suzu High.” She is fiercely loyal to her friends, has a strong sense of justice, and is quick to fight. [Minami Natsuno] is her childhood friend and closest confidant, even though they spent some time apart. [Ida Tetsuya], the [head of SIU], blackmails her into investigating [Kurabe Juurou]'s high school undercover.

(A sukeban is a Japanese delinquent schoolgirl, often associated with girl gangs.)
Under the SIU's orders, she hands over the scout unit to [Sekigahara Ei], who had lost his memories.
Takamiya Yuki (2188)

Professor [Takamiya Yuki] in the 2188 world is [Minami Natsuno]'s mother. She uses her maiden name "[Takamiya]," as she's already divorced her husband. She feels bad that her daughter, [Minami], had to go through the divorce.
Shinonome Ryouko

[Shinonome Ryouko] came from the ruined future of 2064. Since an incident during the battle that year, her memories have been confused. Her strong feelings for [Ida Tetsuya] turned into a desire for revenge, and she relentlessly pursued the culprit. Unless she takes her medicine regularly, severe headaches cause her to lose consciousness.

(First-year students call her Shinonome-senpai. Senpai is an honorific used for a senior student or colleague.)

After being forcibly shifted to [Sector 4] during the Sentinel Infection Incident, she was questioned by police in 1984. They dismissed her accounts of Sentinels and kaiju as delusions caused by mental illness, leaving her in a desperate situation until Ida took her into his protection.
Whenever [Shinonome] sees [Amiguchi Shuu], she feels a strange surge of jealousy... or affection. She comes to realize that his eyes and behavior are just like [Ida]'s.

Watching surveillance footage at the underground facility in 2105, [Shinonome] learned [Ida]'s true feelings and intentions. [Shinonome] realized [Ida] was fixated solely on [Kisaragi Tomi] and had no intention of saving [Shinonome] or the others. Unable to contain her surging emotions, she shot [Ida] dead.

Because of her feelings for [Ida], [Shinonome] was deceived into inserting [DD-426] into [Sekigahara Ei]'s [Sentinel]. During the battle in 2064, [DD-426] contaminated the [Sentinel], causing brain damage to [Kurabe Juurou], [Sekigahara], and [Shinonome]. After the forced shift, [Shinonome] went missing. She was found too late to stop her memory loss, and eventually forgot almost everything, even her own name. But she still remembered [Sentinel No. 14], which [Ida] had prepared for her. [Morimura] and the others tried everything to obtain the password that would remove the contamination from the [Sentinels], but failed.
When the [kaiju] appeared in 1985, [Shinonome] activated [Sentinel No. 14] while still carrying her feelings for [Ida] in her heart.
Shinonome Ryouko (2188)

In footage from 2188, [Shinonome Ryouko], devastated after being used by [Ida Tetsuya], says she has lost faith in humanity. She explains that she altered the colonization program so heavy machinery would seize all [sectors]. The final phase would then reset each time, trapping Project Ark in an endless loop.
Okino Tsukasa

[Okino Tsukasa] is a boy genius with an exceptionally high IQ. He developed a range of technology, including the [Sentinels], to support the defense corps. Driven solely by curiosity, he tends to ignore what others say and act on his own. In 1944, he dresses as a girl and goes by [Douji Kiriko].

Because he had used [DD-426] on himself to separate the [D-Code], he was unaffected by the [Sentinel] Infection Incident in 2064. Separating the [D-Code] cost him his memories, but he had stored them in his nanomachines and implanted a simulated personality in his brain that would make the same judgments as his original self. To others, he was indistinguishable from the original [Okino].

Back in 1944, when [Okino] called himself [Douji Kiriko], he operated on [Hijiyama Takatoshi] and [Miura Keitarou] to ensure their synchronicity with the Sentinels. In doing so, he implanted a linking component into their heads.

To reactivate the [Sentinels] disabled by [DD-426], [Okino] created a code called the Nanomachine Reconstruction Scan. It rebuilt nanomachines to neutralize [DD-426]. He applied it to [Miura (Sentinel No. 19)] to complete the [Sentinel] activation data, then arranged for that data to spread to other pilots through contact with [Miura].
Okino Tsukasa (2188)
The [Okino Tsukasa] of 2188 was in a romantic relationship with [Hijiyama Takatoshi]. As a result of the shootout in [Sector 4], he was shot and killed by the [Izumi Juurou] of that time period.

The [Okino] of 2188 was the brilliant engineer who created Universal Control. But he was remarkably irresponsible: while building it, he even reused part of the system from the simulation game [Mighty Kaiju Deimos].
DNA testing of the 15 people selected for Project Ark revealed that he was [Morimura Chihiro]'s son.
Douji Kiriko
[Douji Kiriko] is [Professor Douji]'s daughter. She's visiting the factory on behalf of the professor.
[Douji Kiriko] is an alias used by [Okino Tsukasa] while dressed as a girl. The real Douji Kiriko lives in Tokyo.
Okino Tsukasa (Two loops ago)

The [Okino Tsukasa] from [two loops ago] (32 years ago) survives the war. Along with his friends [Izumi Juurou] and [Morimura], he goes down the giant tunnel that the kaiju created and discovers Universal Control, how to shift between different [sectors], and the countdown to the destruction of their world. Although he was able to send [Izumi] and [Morimura] to the next [loop] by shifting them to [Sector 0], he himself disappeared along with that world.
Aiba Erika

[Aiba Erika] is a student in Class 1-D. She's a mysterious girl who has a unique point of view, despite her placid personality. As a lover of mystery novels, she enjoys comparing [Takamiya Yuki] to Holmes and herself to Watson as she assists in [Takamiya]'s search for [Minami Natsuno].

According to [Ogata Nenji], who's in the same class as [Aiba], the girl named [Aiba] has been absent from school for a while now. He also claims that she and the person who's been following [Takamiya] are not the same.

[426] took over the android body housing [Kurabe Tamao]'s simulated personality. Soon after taking over [the Tamao android], a track team manager mistook him for a prospective club member named “[Aiba Erika]” while he was in the clubroom. He began using that name. Just before [Aiba] jumped from Sumire Bridge, [Takamiya] asked what she had been doing to her. She replied that she had been preparing for the game that was about to begin.
Kurabe Tamao (2188)

In 2188, she is [Morimura Chihiro]'s mentor, as well as a leading authority on artificial intelligence. Despite the fact that she's 120 years old, she looks much younger than her true age thanks to nanomachine treatments.

Because the technology of the time could not sustain life across a journey of many light-years, [Kurabe Tamao] planned to transport only genetic information for Project Ark, then recreate living beings through cloning at the destination. Believing that humanity could only remain human by passing on its culture and knowledge, she also devised growth pods to provide twenty years of education in a virtual world.
Kurabe Tamao (1945)
She lives in 1945 with [Miura Keitarou]'s younger sister, [Chihiro].

[Kurabe Tamao] has repeatedly been receiving medicine from [Gouto Renya], which causes her to suddenly remember strange dreams. However, she starts receiving a different type of medicine one day that has the opposite effect, causing her to forget what she sees in her dreams.

After the kaiju invasion of 1945, [Tamao] collapsed from exhaustion amid the burned-out ruins and vanished before [Miura Keitarou] and the others. She had not died. Instead, she remained trapped in a pod, kept alive there until the world's end.
Once [Tamao] hears from [Douji Kiriko] that her parents aren't her real ones, and that she was brought here from the future, she can't help but sense that it's the truth.
Kurabe Tamao (One loop ago)
The AI of [Kurabe Tamao] that was born [one loop ago].

Before [426] took over [the Tamao android], its body housed [Kurabe Tamao]'s AI. In the girls' bathroom, Tamao fought [the Kisaragi Tomi android (426)], which had been stalking [Minami Natsuno]. She badly damaged [the Kisaragi android] and cornered [426], but he seized her body instead, erasing her AI.

The 2025 battle had left [Izumi Juurou] on the verge of becoming a shell of himself, so she changed his personality to that of the quiet, obedient [Kurabe Juurou]. Taking pity on [Yakushiji Megumi], who still cared for the former [Izumi], she allowed [Yakushiji] to live with [Kurabe] to keep watch over him.
Kurabe Tamao (1985)

The landlady of the [Kurabe House]. She's [Kurabe Juurou]'s grandmother, who's also close with [Minami Natsuno] through her long-standing friendship with the neighboring [Minami House]. She's currently visiting her relatives over in Shimane.

When the [Kurabe Tamao] from [one loop ago] arrived in 1985, the AI [Kurabe Tamao (Granny)], originally from 1985, was erased by [Universal Control] since they are the same person. To eliminate any discrepancies, the erased Tamao was established to be "visiting relatives in Shimane."
[Chihiro] is [Miura Keitarou]'s younger sister. She loves [Miura] and calls him Nii-chan. She's under [Kurabe Tamao]'s care in 1945.

She is a copy of [Morimura Chihiro], created during a [compatibility] experiment. [Morimura] sealed her original memories at birth, and she lived an ordinary life as [Miura]'s younger sister. After [Gouto Renya] read [Morimura]'s experiment log dated March 2, 2100, he took her from the [Miura House] and reawakened [Morimura]'s sealed memories. [Gouto] also provided her kindergarten uniform.

For the compatibility experiment, [Morimura] believed she had transplanted her own memories (previously saved in [Sector 0]) over to her clone, [Chihiro]. However, the memories that she transplanted from [Sector 0] actually belonged to Professor [Morimura Chihiro] from 2188.
She was the one who killed [Morimura-sensei].

When [Chihiro] awakened the memories of Professor [Morimura Chihiro] from 2188, she witnessed the devastation from the [kaiju] invasion and how far events had strayed from the original Project Ark plan. [Chihiro] decided to start the world over, remove the causes of that deviation, and see the project succeed. She regarded [Morimura]—another person bearing the name '[Morimura Chihiro]' who intended to carry out [Operation Aegis]—as an obstacle, and [Chihiro] killed her.

Although [Chihiro] was born on March 2, 2100, the memories within her belong to Professor [Morimura Chihiro] from 2188. She therefore lacks the memories held by the [Morimura] from [two loops ago], including events from [two loops ago] and from before [Chihiro]'s birth in the current loop. Instead, she remembers Project Ark and the simulated world, her romantic feelings for [Izumi Juurou], and her maternal feelings toward [Okino Tsukasa]—all memories from 2188.
Morimura-sensei
The [Sakura High School] nurse who's also the homeroom teacher of Class 1-B, which [Kurabe Juurou] and [Fuyusaka Iori] are in.

From the records of 2188, [Morimura] learns that humanity became extinct and that the [Morimura] of 2188 was responsible. Afraid that someone else might discover this, she secretly deletes the 2188 records. When [Morimura] accesses an artificial satellite in orbit, she learns that the [facility] sustaining this world is nearing the end of its service life, making this the final loop. She considers carrying out [Operation Aegis] to completely eliminate the kaiju, even if it means living out the rest of her life in a ruined world.
[Morimura-sensei] has been in love with [Izumi Juurou] since she was young.
She is the grown-up [Morimura Chihiro] from [two loops ago]. When the world was reset, the [Morimura] recorded in [Sector 0] was recreated as a simulated personality in the new world.
Woman Who Looks Like Morimura-sensei
The woman from [Amiguchi Shuu]'s dream who looks just like [Morimura-sensei].
She also looks like the woman who appears in [Kurabe Juurou]'s dreams, who also looks like [Fuyusaka Iori].
She is [Morimura-sensei].
Shiba Kyuuta

[Shiba Kyuuta] is [Kurabe Juurou]'s childhood friend who's also into sci-fi and special effects films. He's the life of the party, easy to get along with, and is always making jokes. He seems to have a mysterious power.

An artificial personality 48Q that only [Kurabe] is able to see. [Shiba] claims that he's [Izumi Juurou] and that his memories are already inside [Kurabe]'s head.

(In Japanese, 48Q is a play on words of Shiba's name. 4 can be read as shi, 8 can be read as hachi, and Q and Kyu sound similar. "Ha" sounds can also be turned into "ba", due to the usage of diacritic marks, called dakuten. With this, shi + ba + Q makes 48Q. QTA_CBA also plays on his name. Q + ta can be read as Kyuuta, and C + ba as Seeba. Combining them creates a reading close to his full name.)

His true identity is [426]. The violent memories of [Izumi] implanted by [Morimura] conflicted with the gentle personality created by [Kurabe Tamao], leaving [Kurabe Juurou]'s personality on the verge of breaking down. To prevent that, [Shiba] transformed [Izumi]'s violent memories into dreams, letting [Kurabe] view them from an outside perspective.
Shippo
A mysterious talking cat who offers [Yakushiji Megumi] a deal. He enters a contract with [Yakushiji], promising he'll grant her wish of saving [Kurabe Juurou] if she carries out a dangerous mission.

After [Yakushiji] shoots herself in the stomach with the [Magical Gun] and loses consciousness, [Shippo] reveals his hidden intentions to her and leaves. He had been describing matters concerning the [Sentinels] to her using the word [Magic].

[Shippo]'s true identity was both [426] and [Izumi Juurou]. To prevent the [kaiju] invasion from destroying the world, [Shippo] enlisted [Yakushiji] to inject nanomachines into the 'witches,' unlocking the full [Deimos] game system. This also attracted [kaiju] with far deadlier abilities than the previous [kaiju], but unlocked useful defenses: defeating a [kaiju] earned Meta-Chips as points, and those chips could be spent to strengthen the [Sentinels].
A cute stray cat that [Okino Tsukasa] takes care of at Sakura High. He started living on campus when [Okino] happened upon him and began to feed him. He's earned quite a few fans at the school.
He looks like [Shippo], but they are two different cats.
A small, mysterious robot (60 cm tall) that [Minami Natsuno] finds. He requests [Minami]'s cooperation in finding the memory cell.

'[BJ]' isn't a name. It is part of the coordinates [BJ-011-005] identifying the memory cell [BJ] was searching for. When he first met [Minami], he kept repeating '[BJ]'. Thanks to [Minami]'s good memory, they were able to identify the coordinates without difficulty.
During the [kaiju] invasion of 2064, '[Miura]' escaped into a drone before [Sentinel No. 17] was transferred. He's also a friend of [Sekigahara Ei].
[BJ]'s true identity is [Miura Keitarou] from the past world.
Ida Tetsuya

[Ida Tetsuya] is a part-time instructor at [Sakura High School] and the homeroom teacher for [Shinonome Ryouko]'s class. In fact, he belongs to an unofficial organization and draws [Shinonome] into the fighting.
[Ida] is also the director of the Special Investigations Unit, a government spy agency organized as a special corporation.
He serves as a strategist for the defense operation and helps [Morimura] coordinate the team.

As a student, he supported [Kisaragi Tomi]'s singing livestreams under the handle 'FE8'. In middle school, he wore glasses and had a studious, serious air. Once he entered high school, he began acting like a delinquent to catch [Kisaragi]'s attention.

He was in love with the deceased [Kisaragi], so in order to revive her, he developed [androids] at Shikishima Industries in 2100. He transplanted the past [Kisaragi] and [Kurabe Tamao]'s AI into [androids].
[Ida] is genetically identical to [Amiguchi Shuu].
He saved a simulated personality in [Sector 0] in preparation for the next loop.
Sawatari Miwako

[Sawatari Miwako] is a good friend of [Fuyusaka Iori] and [Kisaragi Tomi]. The three of them often snack on something on their way home from school. She's a kind and reserved girl who's self-conscious about her plump figure.
[Sawatari] was nowhere to be seen after the group returned from the ruins of 2025. She has no memories at all of being there.
[Chihiro] evacuated her from the battlefield of [Sector 4] to the safety of [Sector 3].
Inaba Miyuki
[Inaba Miyuki] is the new idol gaining popularity on TV in 1985. She has an ethereal, graceful presence to her. Rumors say she'll be making an appearance on the Kouhaku music show.

The grown-up version of [Kisaragi Tomi] from another world. When she streamed her singing online, [Ida Tetsuya] encouraged her under the handle “FE8”, inspiring her to pursue singing seriously. To evade [Universal Control]'s surveillance, she entered this world through her singing and began communicating with [Amiguchi Shuu] through his television.
During the Sentinel Infection Incident of 2064, [Inaba] was controlling Sentinel No. 16 when it was shifted to the [orbiting command ship].

One loop ago, when their final defense failed, an explosion occurred while [Kisaragi] and the others were shifting as the world reset. Some of their data was damaged before it could be fully converted, so they were not transferred when the next world began.
Wajima Takemi

[Wajima Takemi] is a delinquent student in 1985 and a leader among the troublemakers at [Nigakuri Industrial School] (Kuri High for short). Nicknamed 'Tak of Kuri High,' he looks intimidating and talks like a delinquent. He tries to seem tough in a fight, but often ends up getting beaten himself.
He fell for [Fuyusaka Iori] at first sight and keeps pressuring her to go out with him.
Izumi Juurou (Two loops ago)

During the kaiju invasion [two loops ago] (32 years ago), [Izumi Juurou] arrived at a mysterious underground facility, along with his friends [Okino Tsukasa] and [Morimura]. With [Okino]'s help, [Izumi] and [Morimura] manage to escape the end of that world, but due to their radical actions in an attempt to change the future, [Izumi] gets captured by the government and becomes known as prisoner number [426].
Man Who Looks Like Kurabe Juurou
The man who appears and fights alongside the woman who looks like [Fuyusaka Iori] in [Kurabe Juurou]'s dream.
Prisoner E-426 was arrested in 2104 for carrying out a terrorist bombing. He is now known as [426].
What [Izumi Juurou] from [two loops ago] looks like after 16 years.

His real name is [Izumi Juurou]. He is already dead; what remains is an artificial recreation based on his memory data recorded in [Sector 0]. He had previously researched how to download memories using the [innerlocitor] and how to infiltrate the [Deimos Code] production line. He escaped by transferring his data into an [android] resembling [Kisaragi Tomi].
[The Kisaragi android] that [426] was using as his body got destroyed during the battle against [the Kurabe Tamao android] in 1985. He then took over [the Tamao android]'s body and managed to escape.

When [the Tamao android] was being used as [426]'s body, [Sekigahara Ei] discovered his true identity and destroyed it. Soon after, [Kurabe Juurou] happens to pass by the destroyed remains and [426] transfers to his nanomachines.
[Kurabe] sees him as [Shiba Kyuuta].
[Yakushiji Megumi] sees him as [Shippo].
His true identity is [Izumi Juurou] from [two loops ago].
He tried to kill every candidate [one loop ago], believing the [kaiju] invasion would stop if no one remained to issue orders using the [D-Code] [control key].
Onishi Heizou

[Onishi Heizou] is a plainclothes police officer in the juvenile division of the Kamazumi Police Force. He cracks down hard on juvenile delinquency and reckless behavior, but he is compassionate, and the boys he has dealt with affectionately call him Onihei. Even on nights when he is off duty, he tries to patrol the streets and watch over the local children. He also knows [Wajima Takemi].
He's particularly concerned about [Takamiya Yuki], as he's had to take her into custody many times. He's aware of her family situation, too.
The professor's real name is [Heizou]. In 1945, he is involved in developing a secret weapon to fight the Americans. He has a daughter named [Douji Kiriko].

[Professor Douji] suspected [Okino Tsukasa], who had been sheltering [Sekigahara Ei], of being a spy who stole classified information. He had the military police pursue him in an attempt to capture him.
Takamiya Heita
[Takamiya Heita] is [Takamiya Yuki]'s father. He's serving a prison sentence for assault and attempted murder, and he's [Takamiya]'s only blood relative.
Sakura High School's track team is hardly among the strongest, but its popular captain, who has competed at the Inter-High championships, does a good job keeping the team together.

The manager is troubled by the repeated vandalism of the track clubroom and by [Minami Natsuno] slipping away in the middle of practice. The team member with pigtails is in the same grade as [Minami], and the two are good friends.

Members of the Special Investigations Unit skilled in combat and intelligence gathering. Most are former Self-Defense Forces personnel or police officers, and they undertake dangerous missions for substantial pay.

[Wajima Takemi]'s loyal crew. Usually caught up in his messes. Still, no matter how many times [Wajima] gets beaten up by [Ogata Nenji] or [Takamiya Yuki], they'll stick by him no matter what. Starting from the left, their nicknames are "Teru," "Masa," "Shacho," and "Nobu."
Ogata Kengo

Father of the 2188 [Ogata Nenji], as well as the chairman of Shikishima Group. He died in 2187, but he left behind a simulated AI construct of his personality. He is responsible for manipulating Professor [Morimura] and pressing Project Ark forward, planning to revive himself through the use of the [innerlocitor] and cloning technology on the new Earth.
The main transfer device is underground. From surface locations such as [Tokisaka Shrine] and [Sakura High School's science room], the [gates] are merely operated remotely.
The [gates] can be used because [Morimura] added that functionality.

An android with a human-shaped skeleton. Its exoskeleton is made of titanium reinforced with carbon nanotubes and covered in high-quality silicone skin, making it nearly impossible to distinguish from a person at a glance. Its internal battery can run for 120 years without recharging.

An [android] that looks like [Kisaragi Tomi]. It was developed by [Ida Tetsuya] in 2100. Soon after the AI of the past [Kisaragi] was transplanted into it, [426] seized his chance to take over the [android].
Although this was destroyed during the battle against [the Kurabe Tamao android] in 1985, [426] manages to take over [the Tamao android]'s body.
After being destroyed in the girls' bathroom, [426] ([Izumi Juurou]) hides the android husk inside the broom cupboard of the old school building.
An [android] that looks like [Kurabe Tamao]. It was developed by [Ida Tetsuya] and [Tamao]'s memories were transplanted into it.
During the battle against [the Kisaragi Tomi android (426)] in 1985, [Tamao]'s body is taken over by [426].
[The Tamao android (426)] was cornered by [Morimura] and the others, then jumped off [Sumire Bridge].

[Sekigahara Ei] discovered that [426] had taken over [the Tamao android] and badly damaged it. [426] then transferred into [Kurabe Juurou]'s nanomachines as he happened to pass by, becoming [Shiba Kyuuta]. [The Tamao android] was left an empty shell and hidden in a nearby garbage collection area.
The gun has a built-in biometric authentication system. It can be configured so that even if someone steals it, they cannot shoot its registered user.

The gun that [Sekigahara Ei] uses was given to him by the [Kisaragi Tomi android], along with some medicine, when they escaped the underground Shikishima Tech Lab in 2104 after the Sentinel Infection Incident.
An unusually shaped gun given to [Yakushiji Megumi] by [Shippo]. Anyone shot with it has hazy memories of what happened immediately before and after being shot.
This [Magical Gun] is identical to the one used by the woman who looks like [Fuyusaka Iori] at the end of [Kurabe Juurou]'s dream (in which he killed everyone).
A gun meant to “seal a witch's authority.” Witches shot with the [Magical Gun] are forcibly drawn into a game of survival.
In 1976, when [Ogata Nenji] was seven years old, [Morimura-sensei] (someone believed to be an adult [Fuyusaka]) injected him with nanomachines to prepare the [Sentinels].

Pills [Morimura-sensei] gives to [Shinonome Ryouko] in the nurse's office, telling her to take them when her headaches are severe. They reportedly cause confusion and memory problems as side effects, and their large size makes them difficult to swallow.

The bottle is labeled [Oral NM: C0204]. These pills slow the contamination caused by [DD-426] and help preserve fading memories. They contain the same ingredients as the medicine the [Kisaragi Tomi android] made for [Sekigahara Ei] in 2104, before he lost his memories.
[Sekigahara], prior to losing his memories, delivered these pills to [Morimura] in order to save [Kurabe Juurou] and [Shinonome].
A device that [Okino Tsukasa] created to look inside a person's mind. He uses it to search for the [key] hidden inside [Ogata Nenji]'s memories.
[Okino] used this to examine [Hijiyama Takatoshi]'s mind. The mental state of whoever wears the [headgear] appears as numerical readings.
Before losing his memories, [Sekigahara Ei] used this device to extract his own memories and write them into the nanomachines in his brain.
[Okino] uses this to gain control over [426], who had escaped into [Kurabe Juurou].
An ampoule [Shinonome Ryouko] found beside [Fuyusaka Iori]'s pillow while she was sleeping in the nurse's office. Labeled [NM0206], it had contained the nanomachines administered to [Fuyusaka].

The name of a worldwide manufacturing system that is fully automated. Computers handle everything from design and production to transport and management without any human involvement. Factories around the world coordinate production for greater efficiency. Their numbers began to grow rapidly around 2080, and by 2142, 1.2 billion factories were operating. Some of the world's largest plants are in Kolkata and Chennai, India.
The [Izumi Juurou] from [two loops ago] discovered that parts of the [automated factory]'s control system could be altered, laying the groundwork for the creation of the [Sentinels].

Today's automated factories are computer-programmed virtual factories. With production times reduced to a minimum and the broad range of technologies available in 2188, they can produce almost anything in virtually unlimited quantities.

Innerlocitor refers to both the nanomachines and the technology used to rewrite memories. It sends information directly to the brain's synapses, making it possible to transplant memories into another body. In March 2188, [Newmen, Inc.], then the leader in innerlocitor technology, partnered with [Shikishima], leading to rapid advances. Since then, human trafficking and illegal cloning intended to achieve 'reincarnation' have become widespread.

No one knows who implanted the [innerlocitors] in the 15 boys and girls. More than 80% of the [innerlocitor]'s functions are used for some unknown purpose, while only a tiny fraction of the remaining 20% is used to process the [D-Code].
Eighty percent of the [innerlocitor]'s functions manage its user's sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch, making experiences in the virtual world feel real.
Activating every self-defense system in a [sector] severs the city from [Universal Control]. It can then no longer be administered or controlled, and all its residents disappear.

When the [kaiju] attack, the underground mainframe is hacked to force the [terminals'] [Aegis System] (self-defense system) to activate. The [terminals] then automatically attack and destroy every [kaiju]. But activating the [Aegis System] disables the time machine, making it impossible to start over. The survivors must live in their ruined world, though they can survive until their natural lifespans end.
Once the [Aegis System] is activated at all [terminals], the [loop] function can no longer be used, and the world will not be rebuilt.

[DD-426] is the program code that [Ida Tetsuya] gives to [Shinonome Ryouko], supposedly to greatly increase the [Sentinels'] capabilities. [Shinonome] ends up installing this into [Sekigahara Ei]'s [Sentinel].

A virus-like program that attacks the brain's [nanomachine] system. It physically severs some [nanomachine] connections to the cerebral cortex, which governs memory. As those connections are gradually torn away, the brain suffers damage, causing intense pain and memory loss. In the worst cases, the victim is left a shell of their former self.

Upon discovering that this program code could be used to sever the [Deimos Code], [Okino Tsukasa] tested the code on himself one year ago. However, he suffered gradual memory loss, so he had no choice but to become an AI with a simulated personality.
[Morimura] and [Gouto Renya] tried to make [Shinonome] remember the password to disable [DD-426], but they failed, and she lost all her memories.
In 1945, [DD-426] was disabled thanks to the Nanomachine Reconstruction Scan developed by [Okino] and the efforts of [Miura Keitarou].
[Ida] used [DD-426] to sabotage the Sentinel Project. He had already given up on the current world and wanted to begin another loop as soon as possible.
[Shippo] explains to [Yakushiji Megumi] that the [Deimos Code] is a relic of an ancient civilization that destroyed another world.
Also called the [D-Code] for short. Its [commander] broadcasts signals ordering the kaiju to attack.
The [D-Code] maintains a single commander and regularly accesses three locations: Universal Control, the automated factory in Sector 1, and something in satellite orbit.

This code was written in 2188, 20 million years ago, during the age of an ancient civilization, to destroy humanity. It was created by the researcher [Shinonome Ryouko], who had lost faith in humanity and wished for a peaceful world without humans.
In an experiment to see whether a copied body could gain [compatibility], [Morimura] used data she had stored in [Sector 0] to create a copy of herself. She said the copy did not become compatible.
The [Control Key] is a program code held by one of the 15 people. Until the world is destroyed, its holder's body emits signals that produce and summon the [kaiju], regardless of the holder's will.
[Ogata Nenji] initially held the [control key], but it later passed to [Minami Natsuno].
Because anyone with an [innerlocitor] can become a commander, obstructing the commander who holds the [control key] would accomplish nothing. Someone else would simply take over that role.
The [kaiju] invasions have caused the world to reset every 16 years. The youths die without ever reaching adulthood, only to be born again and repeat the same cycle. This is called a [loop].

The 15 began to be raised once [terraforming] of the new planet was complete, though no one knows when [terraforming] ended. That leaves the start of the [loop] and the number of cycles so far unknown. Judging by the expected service life of the [facility], however, at least 300 cycles have likely passed.
The boys and girls are not on Earth. They are on a planet whose surface the [D-forces] developed after [terraforming].

The probes contain structural memory devices called “memory cubes” that let them repair themselves by comparing their structures with nearby probes. A probe that can no longer be repaired effectively dies, much like a living organism. Carrying the genetic data of the 15, the countless probes that departed Earth continued to reproduce and expand their range as they sought a new planet where humanity could settle.

A theory proposed by Professor [Takamiya Yuki] in the 2180s and adopted for [Project Ark]. To preserve genetic information, deep-space probes mine resources from asteroids, replicate themselves, and set out again. Even if unforeseen accidents cut off some routes, countless probes continue to reproduce and break down, spreading through space like living organisms until they eventually reach their destination.
They were designed by [Okino Tsukasa] and manufactured in an [automated factory].

Due to the effects of [DD-426], pilots who enter their [Sentinels] can suffer brain damage and memory loss and, in the worst cases, be left severely incapacitated. Remaining inside for even a few minutes is said to be life-threatening.

Each [Sentinel] pilot has an activation marker, a switch used to activate their [Sentinel]. It is usually located where the nanomachines were injected, but if a code is added later, that becomes the new switch location. Sliding a finger over the activation marker brings up “START” and activates the registered [Sentinel].
The pilot of each respective Sentinel during the final battle was [Ogata Nenji] in No. 10, [Sekigahara Ei] in No. 11, and [Hijiyama Takatoshi] in No. 12.

Sentinel No. 12 originally belonged to [Okino Tsukasa], but he hid it in the ocean of Sector 5 so that [Morimura] and the others wouldn't find and retrieve it. In case something happened to him, [Okino] registered [Hijiyama] as its pilot.
The pilot of each respective Sentinel during the final battle was [Kurabe Juurou] in No. 13, [Shinonome Ryouko] in No. 14, and [Fuyusaka Iori] in No. 15.
During the battle in 2064, [Sekigahara Ei] piloted Sentinel No. 15.
The pilot of each respective Sentinel during the final battle was [Kisaragi Tomi] in No. 16, [Minami Natsuno] in No. 17, and [Miura Keitarou] in No. 19.
The latest [Sentinels] can fly using two massive tiltrotors. The four units—No. 20, No. 21, No. 22, and No. 23—were designed to support the other Sentinels.
The pilot of each respective Sentinel during the final battle was [Amiguchi Shuu] in No. 20, [Takamiya Yuki] in No. 21, [Gouto Renya] in No. 22, and [Yakushiji Megumi] in No. 23.
A Sentinel’s cockpit. The pilot is naked while inside.
Even attacking a [kaiju] would subject the pilots of the [Sentinels] to a tremendous shock. That's why [Okino Tsukasa]'s original design did not include a [cockpit].
A weaponized mech that predates the Sentinels. It carries a 16-tube multiple rocket launcher and two Gatling guns. With no close-combat weapons, it was defenseless once the kaiju closed in.

First-generation Sentinel armament.
Fires an electromagnetic pulse forward, disabling enemy electronics. Because it draws enemy attention, it can be used when the Sentinel needs to act as a decoy. It can also stop the rotors of flying enemies, causing them to crash.

Second-generation Sentinel armament.
Its warhead has a hardened nickel-chromium-molybdenum steel tip. After the tip penetrates a kaiju's thick armor, explosives in the rear of the missile detonate with a delay. The thicker and harder the target's armor, the more destructive the impact.

Third-generation Sentinel armament.
Rapidly fires large-caliber shells over long distances. Its formal designation is a 22-caliber, 46 cm six-barrel gun. It can fire up to 85 rounds per minute; each shell weighs 1.5 tons and leaves the barrel at up to 1,050 m/s.

Third-generation Sentinel armament.
The missiles use inertial guidance, calculating their flight paths with accelerometers and controlling their orientation with gyroscopes. Just before impact, they switch to active laser homing, illuminating their targets to guide themselves accurately onto the kaiju.

Third-generation Sentinel armament.
Fires highly penetrating anti-ground missiles at distant kaiju, targeting their weak points. The formal designation is an armor-piercing, fin-stabilized, discarding-sabot missile. Its rod-shaped tungsten-alloy penetrator strikes at 1,800 m/s; on impact, the penetrator and the kaiju's armor behave like fluids, allowing it to pierce through.

Fourth-generation Sentinel armament.
Releases a floating mine that remains in place until a kaiju approaches, then explodes. Its heat is intended to damage the target from within, rather than relying on the blast's impact. It distinguishes Sentinels from kaiju by analyzing the shape of reflected radar waves, preventing accidental detonation.

Fourth-generation Sentinel armament.
Drives spikes on the legs through a kaiju's armor and discharges electricity directly inside. A surge of high-energy electrons causes tremendous heat through vibrations of metal molecules, destroying the kaiju's electronic equipment.

Fourth-generation Sentinel support equipment.
Launches four agile interceptor drones that automatically track and attack kaiju. After the Hunters' fast aerial assaults on the terminals proved so difficult to stop, Okino Tsukasa studied their flight systems and designed these drones.
Chobham Armor
A large object that arrived like a meteor and continued moving, destroying numerous buildings along its path.
In the 2065 ruins, [Minami Natsuno] witnesses a giant, four-legged machine that looks just like the weapons that the aliens used in the sci-fi classic, "[The War of the Worlds]."

A hologram projected from the remains of a kaiju in 2025 delivered this announcement in a mechanical voice: ‘Shikishima Space Development Project No. 8834. Planetary Terraforming Plan, Phase 3: Surface Construction and Modification. D-Series D-800 Giant Moler, colossal autonomous heavy machinery and large-scale crust excavation unit.’

The kaiju were a program created by [Shinonome Ryouko] in 2188 using the simulation game [Deimos] to attack the virtual world. Her aim was to prevent humanity from ever setting foot on the newly terraformed planet.

Officially called "Small Wrecker."
Only 8 m long and small by kaiju standards, these machines still pose a grave threat to humans. Like army ants, they swarm over buildings to attack in large groups. They carry a high-output directed-energy weapon.

D-Series product No. D-800.
A massive crust-excavation machine developed by Shikishima Industries for Phase 3 of the Terraforming Project: surface construction and modification. Built to operate under extreme atmospheric pressure and gravity, it has a special steel outer shell that can withstand lava temperatures. It walks on three legs to reach excavation sites under its own power and can operate continuously for up to 180 days.

Officially called "High Speed Transporter."
A flying scout-drone kaiju, 5 m long, that uses two massive [tiltrotors] for high-speed flight. These drones fly in formation and attack with small excavation lasers.

Officially called "Flying Drill Machine."
An aerial excavation kaiju over 20 m long. Its six rotors produce a deafening roar exceeding 130 decibels. Its ability to fly without following roads makes it highly mobile, and it attacks from above with machine guns and missiles.

These were once thought to be [First-generation Sentinels] seized during the [kaiju] invasion of 2064 and turned into enemy [kaiju]. In fact, they are new [kaiju] built from the design data of the [first-generation Sentinels] to counter the increasingly powerful [Sentinels]. They retain tremendous striking power and, despite being prototypes, carry Chobham Armor that makes them highly resistant to weaker attacks.

A high school near the center of Ashitaba City. Each grade has five classes, A through E, and the school has 512 students in total. It is an integrated junior and senior high school, with the same uniform used at both levels.

The main gate used by students and staff of Sakura High School. Facing the campus, the baseball field lies in the foreground to the left, with the clubroom building beyond it. The new school building is on the right, and the old wooden building stands behind it.

The dining area on the first floor of Sakura High School's south building, with a shop selling bread and bento below normal prices. Its most popular item is yakisoba pan, followed by chicken-mayonnaise bento and sandwiches. (1984 survey)

A school facility offering health consultations, guidance, examinations, and emergency treatment for illness or injury. Every day, at least three male students feign illness just to visit Morimura-sensei, the school nurse.

A school room used for chemistry experiments. Rumors tell of voices heard coming from the science room at night, only for it to be empty when entered, and of a strange bluish-white glow visible from the grounds while the room is dark. These tales count among the [seven wonders of the school].

A former gathering spot for delinquents, now officially closed off.
[Amiguchi Shuu] recently forced the lock open, apparently allowing people to come and go freely. A handkerchief believed to belong to a female student is often left hanging out to dry.

A passageway connecting the new and old school buildings.
It originally connected the old building to the auditorium. On the new-building side are the science room and its preparation room.

A wooden school building more than 40 years old.
The floors creak, the doors have grown stiff and difficult to open, and its lighting is still nothing more than bare, small light bulbs, all showing the building's age.

The embankment of the Kaede River overlooks Kasumi-cho.
Few people pass through because it stands considerably higher than the urban area.

Ayame Park sits atop a small hill.
The site was once called Ayame Pass, and an arsenal producing military supplies stood there.

Gogyo Street runs north to south through the high-rise district of Aoi Ward.
Its Suzuna intersection has the highest volume of vehicle traffic in Ashitaba City. Shikishima Industries' headquarters is nearby.
The [gate] that allows travel to another era lies just beyond the torii gate.

An abandoned factory in Higoromo-cho.
It used to be a small factory that produced bolts, nuts, washers, and rubber gaskets. It is now [Okino Tsukasa]'s base of operations.

A room on the fifth floor of the government building in Aoi Ward.
[Ida Tetsuya]'s office.

The 193-meter Sumire Bridge spans the Kaede River.
It dates back to 1673, when the lord of the Satsuki Domain had it built. Originally, five linked arched spans rested on stone-masonry piers.

The cybernetic-organism development room in [Shikishima Tech Lab #6], six floors underground in the 2100s.
The facility experimented with replacing every part of the human body except the brain with artificial components. Here, [Ida Tetsuya] was developing fully artificial humans (droids).
Also called a saucer, this enormous disc-shaped object is 30 km in diameter and lies 300 meters beneath Ashitaba City.

[Universal Control] is the underground mainframe.
It manages all the town's residents; when inconsistencies arise in the world, [Universal Control] may alter their memories or circumstances to resolve them, distorting the truth in the process.
[Okino Tsukasa] developed [Universal Control] in 2188, substituting the simulation game [Deimos] for part of its environmental management system.

A colony under construction in orbit around Earth in 2187.
Once complete, it would measure 30 km across, with several enormous cylindrical food-production silos docked to it.

The site where [Project Ark] was carried out to preserve humanity, but also the origin of the nanomachine infection that destroyed it. In 2188, [Sekigahara Ei], who had infiltrated the colony to assassinate [Morimura], planted a bomb in [Sector 4]'s power-generation area.

This is where [Inaba Miyuki] exists. During the 2064 [Sentinel Infection Incident], [Inaba] ends up shifting outside the world and over to the artificial satellite, where she comes across the 2188 data and learns the truth about the world.

After arriving at the new planet, the probe built and launched an artificial satellite, then constructed the surface facility area. It also built growth pods and began raising the 15 boys and girls from their genetic data. The command ship monitors the surface facilities so it can decide whether to restart the final phase before damage or malfunctions occur there.
The apartment where [Kisaragi Tomi] lived in 2025 was destroyed by the kaiju. The first floor of the building was a cake shop, popular for their [pear tart].

A place more than 15 km from the center of Ashitaba City.
From within the city, the sky and ground seem to stretch on indefinitely, but beyond the 15 km boundary a vast mesh-like structure appears to extend without end. To guide [Amiguchi Shuu] to the residential area's outer wall, [Inaba Miyuki] unlocked part of the Tsuwabuki Bypass.

In 2188, five colonies known as [sectors] orbited Earth.
[Miura Keitarou] gave Project Ark's residential areas the same name, [sectors], because their structures resembled those colonies. [Morimura] and the other Project Ark participants believed the next humanity should begin again in an era before wars fought with nanomachines. Unable to agree which era would produce the most desirable mindset in those born into it, they created residential areas corresponding to five candidate eras, resulting in five [sectors].

Unlike the other five [sectors], this one is unique, as it doesn't take up any space. Since it's unaffected by [loops], [Morimura] and [Ida Tetsuya] used it as an evacuation site where they stored their own data.

When the world [two loops ago] disappeared, [Okino Tsukasa] saved data belonging to [Izumi Juurou] and [Morimura] in Sector 0, unexpectedly allowing them to pass into the next loop. Sector 0 was used to cross loops thereafter, but was actually a storage area allocated to the virtual-world reproduction system for the enormous volumes of data making up each virtual space.

The [facility] contains the structures that make up this world. After so many [loops], its equipment has reached the end of its service life and can no longer be repaired. If kaiju overrun [Sector 4] (1985), another loop will not occur; instead, the entire facility will be rebuilt.
Because that rebuilding includes [Sector 0], where memories have been stored, the world the boys and girls lived in will truly cease to exist.

An incident in which contact with [Miura Keitarou] caused [Kurabe Juurou] to summon a [Sentinel] involuntarily. [Kurabe] transferred the mysterious robot to a video rental shop in the shopping district that he had been thinking about just beforehand.
Television news reported that gas leaked from an aging pipe, causing an explosion that partially damaged the building.

At the dock in 1945, [Okino Tsukasa] modified [Sentinel No. 19] so that its [Sentinel] activation program could be copied simply by making contact with [Miura Keitarou]. This is what caused [Kurabe] to summon the [Sentinel].

A dream [Kurabe Juurou] told [Fuyusaka Iori] about in the science room. In it, two rebels traveled into the past to bomb a space-development facility they believed had caused the world's destruction. They killed researchers and became fugitives. [Kurabe] said the [woman] in a leather jumpsuit looked like [Fuyusaka].

It's actually not a dream, but a real event that [Izumi Juurou (426)] of [two loops ago] and [Morimura] experienced [one loop ago]. After this incident, [Izumi] gets captured by the police and [Morimura] escapes to another sector.
It wasn't actually a fire, but someone trashing the girls' bathroom. Ever since this incident, [Minami Natsuno] stopped showing up at school.

The destruction of the north building girls' bathroom was the result of the battle between [the Kisaragi Tomi android], who was after [Minami], and [Kurabe Tamao]'s [android]. This is also when the entity inside of [the Kisaragi android] and [the Tamao android] switched places.

A defensive battle in central Ashitaba City in 2064.
Four pilots each fought in a [Sentinel], including [Kurabe Juurou (Izumi)], [Shinonome Ryouko], and [Sekigahara Ei]. [Sentinel No. 15], controlled by [Sekigahara], disabled the systems of all the [Sentinels], collapsing the defensive line. [Morimura] prioritized the pilots' lives and forcibly transferred every Sentinel. [Ida Tetsuya] stayed behind to fight using a remotely controlled Sentinel.

The kaiju attack in 2025. [Kurabe Juurou (Izumi)] tries to protect the city by himself, but ends up losing. Following [Kurabe]'s defeat, [Yakushiji Megumi] manages to find him in the ruins, but [Kurabe] had already suffered immense brain damage from piloting the [Sentinel] for two hours straight. He loses consciousness in [Yakushiji]'s arms. Because of this battle, [Kurabe] ends up completely losing his memories.
[Gouto Renya] and [Morimura] carried [Kisaragi Tomi] off from a commercial building in Kamazumi Ward while she was looking for her mother.

The first phase of this space initiative ends with the dispersal of countless [probes] carrying the DNA data of the 15 individuals. The second phase ends when the [terraforming] of the new planet is completed. The final phase refers to the creation of clones from the DNA data of the 15 individuals, through to the point where they turn 20 and safely set foot on the new Earth. The 15 clones spend twenty years living in a virtual world, undergoing a special training program to acquire specialized knowledge during the final two years.

The dream [Kurabe Juurou] sees of him killing everyone.
Seeing this dream makes [Kurabe] anxious that he might end up killing [Yakushiji Megumi], so he starts to avoid her. In his dream, the man called [Izumi Juurou] (who resembles [Kurabe]) claims that the nanomachines in their bodies are what's calling the [Deimos] here. Towards the end of the dream, [Izumi] gets shot by a woman who looks just like [Fuyusaka Iori].

This dream is an incident that occurred [one loop ago], and the person who killed everyone is [Izumi Juurou (426)] from [two loops ago]. There was a total of six deaths, which included [Izumi Juurou] from [one loop ago], [Sekigahara Ei], [Shinonome Ryouko], [Okino Tsukasa], [Yakushiji], and [Morimura].
Sector 5. [Miura Keitarou], [Hijiyama Takatoshi], and [Kurabe Tamao] were born in this era.
Sector 4. [Takamiya Yuki], [Minami Natsuno], and [Ogata Nenji] were born in this era.
Sector 3. [Yakushiji Megumi], [Kisaragi Tomi], and [Amiguchi Shuu] were born in this era. Moreover, [Ida Tetsuya] and [Inaba Miyuki] were born in this era [one loop ago].
Sector 2. [Sekigahara Ei], [Gouto Renya], and [Shinonome Ryouko] were born in this era.
Sector 1. [Izumi Juurou], [Morimura Chihiro], and [Okino Tsukasa] were born in this era.

When [Miura Keitarou] says his friend [Hijiyama Takatoshi] was once "a mess," he was referring to this particular look and attitude.

In the latter half of the Meiji era, Western culture was considered more acceptable as "haikara," the cultural adoption of western fashions, became popular. The term "haikara" was made popular by Meiji-era journalists, derived from the English "high collar."

To counter this movement, "bankara" was born out of a desire for "goodness within"—something not determined by outward appearances. "Bankara" came from the twisting of "haikara," and being "bankara" meant holding onto a crude outer appearance while seeking spiritual nobility, integrity, and greatness on the inside.

A teasing term for a woman with a flat nose, also used as an insult. [Ogata Nenji] threw this insult at [Kisaragi Tomi].

In the original Japanese, the word he uses is "chinkusha," derived from "chin" (Japanese Chin dog) and "kushami" (a sneeze). The Japanese Chin dog's facial features are unusually close together, and the originator of this insult must have imagined that such a dog sneezing would be especially hard on the eyes.

While [Kisaragi] failed to recognize this old-fashioned retort, it was clear that it wasn't a compliment.

These three laws were formulated by Arthur C. Clarke, a leading twentieth-century science-fiction writer known for "2001: A Space Odyssey."

1. When a distinguished but elderly scientist states that something is possible, he is almost certainly right. When he states that something is impossible, he is very probably wrong.

2. The only way of discovering the limits of the possible is to venture a little way past them into the impossible.

3. Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.

Yakisoba coated in a sweet-and-savory sauce, served in a slightly sweet bread roll.
[Hijiyama Takatoshi]’s favorite food. After once dropping a [yakisoba pan] and wasting it, he says the [proper etiquette] is to eat alone somewhere no one can bother him.

[Yakushiji Megumi] blessed [Hijiyama] with her [yakisoba pan] when she happened to pass by as he was about to collapse from hunger. This is the moment [yakisoba pan] became [Hijiyama]'s favorite food, as well as the reason he started calling [Yakushiji] the "Yakisoba Pan Angel."

Though they're lacking a bit of sugar, these ohagi that [Kurabe Tamao] made for [Miura Keitarou] and [Hijiyama Takatoshi] are still soft, moist, and filled with red bean paste. They were given five of each flavor: strained red bean, coarse red bean, and roasted soy flour.

Dinner [Yakushiji Megumi] made for [Kurabe Juurou] the other night. Consists of five dishes: salt-grilled mackerel, chikuzen-ni, a Japanese-style rolled omelet, rice, and miso soup. The chikuzen-ni was served in a large, deep dish so the two could share it.

This generously filled strawberry crêpe comes with plenty of cream and is sold at half price.
[Fuyusaka Iori], [Kisaragi Tomi], and [Sawatari Miwako] enjoy this on their way home from school. Known for a shell that's sweet and crispy up top while soft and moist at the base.

A superb soft serve that offers both a rich flavor and refreshing after-taste.
[Fuyusaka Iori], [Kisaragi Tomi], and [Sawatari Miwako] enjoy this on their way home from school. The fragrant cone is delicious down to the very last bite.

The hot dog, a popular dish that consists of a piping hot sausage placed in the middle of a slightly sweet bun, topped off with the sharp scent of mustard and bold chili sauce.
[Fuyusaka Iori], [Kisaragi Tomi], and [Sawatari Miwako] enjoy this on their way home from school.

A soft, steamy bun loaded with juicy meat.
[Fuyusaka Iori], [Kisaragi Tomi], and [Sawatari Miwako] enjoy this on their way home from school. It tastes even better if you add a bit of mustard.

This chef's masterpiece uses chicken fresh off the farm and sweet, crunchy, long onions that are doused and grilled in a secret sauce. The flavor seems unchanged, yet it shifts subtly every day—a secret that keeps longtime regulars coming back and wins over first-time customers.

A bento with meatballs that [Yakushiji Megumi] made.
[Miura Keitarou] supposedly enjoyed this from atop the embankment overlooking the Kaede River. Aside from the meatballs, the bento has a large umeboshi, hijiki, boiled spinach, kinpira gobo, an omelet, and butter sautéed squash.

Hamburg steak that [Yakushiji Megumi] made.
[Miura Keitarou] praises it and says he's "never had anything so delicious." It's also [Kurabe Juurou]'s favorite dish. Juice oozes out of the soft patty.
[Miura] claims that it's "probably the most delicious thing in the world."
The most popular item from the first floor cake shop at the apartment where [Kisaragi Tomi] used to live. [Kisaragi] and [Yakushiji Megumi] would eat one at least once a week.

"VALKYRIE" is a canned soda that [Ogata Nenji] found for [Kisaragi Tomi] in the 2025 ruins.
No matter how tired you are, one sip of this energy drink will recharge you instantly.

"Fruit Nectar PAW PAW" is a canned juice that [Ogata Nenji] found for [Sawatari Miwako] in the 2025 ruins.
A 30% fruit juice that uses a popular fruit called "papaw," also known as the custard apple.

"Camy" is the cat food that [Yakushiji Megumi] buys for [Shippo].
A luxurious cat food that only uses white tuna.

Canned cat food that [Okino Tsukasa] buys for the stray cat, [Shintaro]. [Shintaro] keeps showing up at [Sakura High School] ever since [Okino] fed him one day, so [Okino] starts bringing the [canned cat food] for him daily.

An online full-dive game produced in 2154 to mark the 200th anniversary of “[Mighty Kaiju Deimos].”

Players become residents of a huge city five days before the kaiju arrive and experience the fateful day of their attack. The goal of this survival simulation is to live through the disaster caused by [Mighty Kaiju Deimos].

From an old woman who runs a tobacco shop to a young man traveling in search of his parents’ killer, around 10 million NPCs live their lives like real people in a city extending 30 km. Even experts would marvel at the AI, sophisticated enough to be indistinguishable from human behavior. The sight of the kaiju destroying the city is spectacular and intensely thrilling. Players can fight back against [Mighty Kaiju Deimos] using a variety of weapons.
Developed by Vanillaware Ltd.
[Okino Tsukasa] borrowed a portion of this game's internal code structure when creating [Universal Control].

A TV special presenting the latest UFO reports alongside shocking footage.
The program is presented in a documentary style. Although UFOs and aliens never actually end up appearing, the search for them is fascinating enough to carry the show.

A sci-fi movie released in 1982.
A touching story about an alien that got stranded on Earth connecting with a young boy. It's famous for the scene where the boy takes flight as he rides his unicycle, the sun setting in the background. [Minami Natsuno] is such a huge fan of the movie, that she watched it three times in theaters AND countless times on TV broadcasts and video. [Minami] claims that one "can't talk about aliens without seeing that movie."

A famous sci-fi novel published in 1898 by H. G. Wells.
Martians invade Earth using three-legged weapons called Tripods. The title, The War of the Worlds, refers to a war between Earth and Mars.

A bag that students use when attending school.
There are a few variants made out of natural leather (mainly cowhide) or artificial leather. Inside [Takamiya Yuki]'s flattened bag is a steel plate instead of textbooks.

A vinyl bag specific to the school.
The material isn't the best. It's uncomfortable when it sticks to your skin on sweaty summer days, and it's cold to the touch during the winter. For some reason, it holds much more than it looks like it should.

A document bearing [Kurabe Juurou]'s photograph, but listing his name as [Izumi Juurou].
It reads, “His mind seems steadier on medication. An obedient personality is emerging. Progress is good.”

The "medication record" that [Shinonome Ryouko] found in the nurse's office that contained the following details:
[Fuyusaka Iori]: Nanomachines anchored. Memory transplant... Attempt #7.
[Shinonome Ryouko]: Memory separation progressing... 3rd phase... Like [Izumi Juurou]... Giving personality formation measures..."

In the nurse's office, [Sekigahara Ei] found the medical records of three students: "[Shinonome Ryouko]," "[Amiguchi Shuu]," and "[Izumi Juurou]." It stated that [Shinonome Ryouko] is being treated with two types of pills, C0204 and C22, in an attempt to delay nanomachine separation in the brain and enhance her memory link. It's been over a week since she last received a dose. [Amiguchi Shuu] was administered a nanomachine medication called NM: A8076 once. There's also a note that says "20% transplant rate." [Izumi Juurou] is receiving two types of treatment, NM: A8075 and B01. He received four doses of A8075, then switched to B01 from the fifth dose on. There's a scribbled note that says "B01 was synthesized by [Kurabe Tamao]."
A matching set of chopsticks used by [Kurabe Juurou] and [Yakushiji Megumi] at dinner. They have a cute cherry-blossom pattern and are made from Japanese ash, a hard yet flexible wood.

The debut song of newcomer idol [Inaba Miyuki].
Released as a single from her debut album, "M'control", it also received a flexi-disc edition. An affordable price helped it become a huge hit, especially among middle and high school students.
Sounds just like the song [Kisaragi Tomi] used to sing in middle school, but arranged in a more '80s style.
Student ID for [Sakura High School]. [Fuyusaka Iori] dropped this on her way to school when she bumped into [Sekigahara Ei].

After [Sekigahara] lost his memories, he finds this student ID in his pocket and realizes that it belongs to "Class 1-B, [Fuyusaka Iori]" of [Sakura High School]. Although [Sekigahara] recognizes [Fuyusaka]'s face, he can't remember how he knows her.
After [Sekigahara Ei] lost his memories, he finds this in his pocket. It's a key for some sort of vehicle and has an emblem on the handle.

[Amiguchi Shuu] rides this motorcycle to school even though it's against the rules.

Shikishima GRD250
Engine Displacement 249cc
45-degree forward-inclined, water-cooled four-cylinder engine
Top speed of 170 km/h
Manufactured by Shikishima in February 1985

[Sekigahara Ei's] motorcycle from the future. Its name is [Shikishima SXR-NR].

It uses a powerful bearingless motor manufactured by [Shikishima Industries] and reaches a top speed of 450 km/h. Its safety features have been improved, and it can stand on its own while stopped or at low speed, preventing skidding with a jet that shoots compressed air. It even has a feature where it finds its way to the owner, thanks to the self-driving and biometric authentication system.
This motorcycle originally belonged to [Morimura], but since [Sekigahara] is borrowing it from her, it is registered as belonging to both [Morimura] and [Sekigahara].

[Ogata Nenji]'s most treasured item when he was in elementary school.
A grade-based educational magazine that was released in 1976. The free gifts attached to this were the "Multiplication Train" and the flexi disc version of "[Terror of Mecha-Deimos]."

Evil organization that appeared in "Kamen Hero Stranger," a TV show that [Ogata Nenji] was obsessed with in second grade. They focused on destroying human society and nature, with Chief Evil at the helm. They consist of the "machine people," humans that were turned into cyborgs, and other nefarious forces of darkness.

[Minami Natsuno] got this when [Kurabe Tamao]'s android shot her in the face. It looks as if she's been stabbed by a needle. [Minami] doesn't remember anything about what happened before or after it. The red marking almost looks like the number 17. Right as she was about to shoot [Minami], [Tamao]'s android said, "Those monsters, the ones that destroyed the city... They have a new commander... And it's you. From now on... your commands will belong to me alone."
[Miura Keitarou] retrieved the stuffed rabbit from the air raid wreckage and handed it to [Chihiro] when they were reunited at Ayame Park in 1985.
A piece of folded paper found in the pocket of the dead woman ([Morimura-sensei]). The two rows of numbers are "[443685 3214]."
These are the numbers for the [message service] in 1985, which [Sekigahara Ei] entrusted to [Morimura] before he lost his memories.

An envelope that was on the ground near where [Sekigahara Ei] woke up. There was a document and a note inside. The document says, "[Morimura Chihiro], 31. Sakura High School nurse. A key member of Shikishima's weapon development team." The note says, "If capture is not possible, then shoot to kill."
[Ida Tetsuya] was the one who instructed [Sekigahara] to kill [Morimura].
[Minami Natsuno]'s notebook begins with the words, “This is an important investigative record that will go down in the history of the universe.”
Investigative Record 1: "...I have finally encountered my destiny. He has arrived from outer space. An actual extraterrestrial being! Aliens really do exist!"

Similar to the glasses that [Takamiya Yuki] finds in the girls' bathroom in the north school building. The glasses that [Kisaragi Tomi] wears have a red frame made of plastic, originally developed for use in airplanes (and thus very light and flexible) so they won't break even if they get twisted. The lenses cut out 100% of ultraviolet rays and high-energy visible light. [Takamiya] thought that [Kisaragi], who has the same exact glasses as the scrapped pair she found, might have something to do with [Minami Natsuno]'s disappearance.

A large old house with a total floor space exceeding 160 square meters. Originally a single-story house, it was later remodeled to add a second floor. [Kurabe Juurou] uses the backroom of the second floor, [Yakushiji Megumi] uses the middle room on the east side of the first floor, and [Miura Keitarou] uses the guest room closest to the entrance area of the first floor.
The [Kurabe Residence Layout] was created by [Miura Keitarou] in 2188, based off of the things [Kurabe Tamao] heard from her grandfather as well as the old films that remained.
